units.zh: 六曰進熟。
units.en: Sixth: presenting the cooked offering.
units.literal: Sixth, presenting the cooked offering.

units.zh: 皇帝既升，奠玉、幣。
units.en: Once the emperor has ascended, he presents jade and silks.
units.literal: After the emperor has ascended, he presents jade and silks.

units.zh: 太官令帥進饌者奉饌，各陳於內壝門外。
units.en: The Imperial Kitchen Director leads food-bearers with the offerings, each placing them outside the inner enclosure gate.
units.literal: The Imperial Kitchen Director leads food-bearers bearing offerings; each arrays them outside the inner enclosure gate.

units.zh: 謁者引司徒出詣饌所，司徒奉昊天上帝之俎，太官令引饌入門，各至其陛。
units.en: An usher leads the Minister over Masses to the offering station, where he bears the tray for the August Supreme Lord of Heaven; the Imperial Kitchen Director leads the offerings through the gate, each to its proper steps.
units.literal: The usher leads the Minister over Masses out to the offering station; the Minister over Masses bears the tray for the August Supreme Lord of Heaven; the Imperial Kitchen Director leads the offerings through the gate, each to its steps.

units.zh: 祝史俱進，跪，徹毛血之豆，降自東陛以出。
units.en: The invokers advance together, kneel, remove the hair-and-blood beans, and descend the eastern steps to exit.
units.literal: Invokers all advance together, kneel, remove the hair-and-blood beans, and descend the eastern steps to exit.

units.zh: 諸太祝迎饌於壇上，司徒、太官令俱降自東陛以出。
units.en: The Chief Invokers receive the offerings on the altar; the Minister over Masses and Imperial Kitchen Director both descend the eastern steps and exit.
units.literal: The various Chief Invokers receive the offerings on the altar; the Minister over Masses and Imperial Kitchen Director both descend the eastern steps to exit.

units.zh: 又進設外官、眾星之饌。
units.en: Offerings for the outer officials and the host of stars are set out next.
units.literal: Offerings for outer officials and the host of stars are presented next.

units.zh: 皇帝詣罍洗，盥手，洗爵，升壇自南陛。
units.en: The emperor goes to the washing urn, washes his hands, rinses the goblet, and ascends the altar by the southern steps.
units.literal: The emperor proceeds to the urn for washing, washes his hands, rinses the goblet, and ascends the altar by the southern steps.

units.zh: 司徒升自東陛，立於尊所。
units.en: The Minister over Masses ascends the eastern steps and stands at the vessel position.
units.literal: The Minister over Masses ascends the eastern steps and stands at the vessel position.

units.zh: 齋郎奉俎從升，立於司徒後。
units.en: Purification youths bearing trays follow him up and stand behind the Minister over Masses.
units.literal: Purification youths bearing trays follow up and stand behind the Minister over Masses.

units.zh: 皇帝詣上帝尊所，執尊者舉冪，侍中贊酌汎齊，進昊天上帝前，北向跪，奠爵，興，少退，立。
units.en: The emperor goes to the Supreme Lord's vessel position; the attendant raises the cover; the Palace Attendant intones as he pours the first libation. He advances before the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, kneels facing north, sets down the goblet, rises, steps back slightly, and stands.
units.literal: The emperor proceeds to the vessel position for the Supreme Lord, the vessel attendant raises the cover, the Palace Attendant intones as he pours the first libation; he advances before the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, kneels facing north, sets down the goblet, rises, steps back slightly, and stands.

units.zh: 太祝持版進於神右，東向跪，讀祝文曰：「維某年歲次月朔日，嗣天子臣某，敢昭告于昊天上帝。」
units.en: The Chief Invoker advances with the prayer board to the spirit's right, kneels facing east, and reads: "In the year ___, on the ___ day of the first month, the heir Son of Heaven, your subject ___, ventures to announce to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven."
units.literal: The Chief Invoker advances with the prayer board to the right of the spirit, kneels facing east, and reads the prayer text: "In such-and-such a year, on such-and-such a day of the first month, the heir Son of Heaven, your subject so-and-so, ventures to announce to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜。
units.en: The emperor bows twice.
units.literal: The emperor bows twice.

units.zh: 詣配帝酒尊所，執尊者舉冪，侍中取爵於坫以進，皇帝受爵，侍中贊酌汎齊，進高祖神堯皇帝前，東向跪，奠，興，少退，立。
units.en: He goes to the associated deity's wine vessel; the attendant raises the cover; the Palace Attendant takes a goblet from the stand and presents it. The emperor receives it; the Palace Attendant intones as he pours the first libation and advances before Emperor Gaozu the Divine Progenitor. He kneels facing east, presents the offering, rises, steps back slightly, and stands.
units.literal: He proceeds to the wine vessel position for the associated deity; the vessel attendant raises the cover; the Palace Attendant takes a goblet from the stand and advances it; the emperor receives the goblet; the Palace Attendant intones as he pours the first libation and advances before Emperor Gaozu the Divine Progenitor; he kneels facing east, presents the offering, rises, steps back slightly, and stands.

units.zh: 太祝持版進於左，北向跪，讀祝文曰：「維某年歲次月朔日，曾孫開元神武皇帝臣某，敢昭告于高祖神堯皇帝。」
units.en: The Chief Invoker advances with the board to the left, kneels facing north, and reads: "In the year ___, on the ___ day of the first month, the great-grandson, the Kaiyuan Divine Martial Emperor, your subject ___, ventures to announce to Emperor Gaozu the Divine Progenitor."
units.literal: The Chief Invoker advances with the board to the left, kneels facing north, and reads the prayer text: "In such-and-such a year, on such-and-such a day of the first month, the great-grandson, the Kaiyuan Divine Martial Emperor, your subject so-and-so, ventures to announce to Emperor Gaozu the Divine Progenitor."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜。
units.en: The emperor bows twice again.
units.literal: The emperor bows twice.

units.zh: 進昊天上帝前，北向立。
units.en: He advances before the August Supreme Lord of Heaven and stands facing north.
units.literal: He advances before the August Supreme Lord of Heaven and stands facing north.

units.zh: 太祝各以爵酌上尊福酒，合置一爵，太祝持爵授侍中以進，皇帝再拜，受爵，跪，祭酒，啐酒，奠爵，俛伏，興。
units.en: Each Chief Invoker pours blessed wine from the upper vessel; they combine it in one goblet; the Chief Invoker gives it to the Palace Attendant to present. The emperor bows twice, receives the goblet, kneels, offers a libation, sips the wine, sets down the goblet, prostrates, and rises.
units.literal: Each Chief Invoker pours blessed wine from the upper vessel with a goblet; they combine it in one goblet; the Chief Invoker presents the goblet to the Palace Attendant to advance; the emperor bows twice, receives the goblet, kneels, offers a libation, sips the wine, sets down the goblet, prostrates, and rises.

units.zh: 太祝各帥齋郎進俎。
units.en: Each Chief Invoker leads purification youths forward with the trays.
units.literal: Each Chief Invoker leads purification youths to advance the trays.

units.zh: 太祝減神前胙肉，共置一俎，授司徒以進，皇帝受以授左右。
units.en: The Chief Invokers cut the sacrificial flesh before the spirits, place it on one tray, and present it through the Minister over Masses; the emperor receives it and hands it to his attendants.
units.literal: The Chief Invokers cut the sacrificial flesh before the spirits, place it together on one tray, and present it through the Minister over Masses; the emperor receives it and hands it to attendants at his sides.

units.zh: 皇帝跪，取爵，遂飲，卒爵。
units.en: The emperor kneels, takes the goblet, drinks, and finishes it.
units.literal: The emperor kneels, takes the goblet, then drinks and finishes the goblet.

units.zh: 侍中進受虛爵，復於坫。
units.en: The Palace Attendant receives the empty goblet and returns it to the stand.
units.literal: The Palace Attendant advances to receive the empty goblet and returns it to the stand.

units.zh: 皇帝俛伏，興，再拜，降自南陛，復于位。
units.en: The emperor prostrates, rises, bows twice, descends the southern steps, and returns to his place.
units.literal: The emperor prostrates, rises, bows twice, descends the southern steps, and returns to his position.

units.zh: 文舞出，武舞入。
units.en: The civil dance exits and the military dance enters.
units.literal: The civil dance exits; the military dance enters.

units.zh: 初，皇帝將復位，謁者引太尉詣罍洗，盥手，洗瓠爵，自東陛升壇，詣昊天上帝著尊所，執尊者舉冪，太尉酌醴齊，進昊天上帝前，北向跪，奠爵，興，再拜。
units.en: When the emperor is about to return to his position, an usher leads the Grand Commandant to the washing urn. He washes his hands, rinses the gourd goblet, ascends by the eastern steps, and goes to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven's sacrificial vessel. The attendant raises the cover; the Grand Commandant pours the second libation, advances before the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, kneels facing north, sets down the goblet, rises, and bows twice.
units.literal: At first, as the emperor is about to return to his position, the usher leads the Grand Commandant to the washing urn; he washes his hands and rinses the gourd goblet, ascends the altar by the eastern steps, proceeds to the sacrificial vessel position for the August Supreme Lord of Heaven; the vessel attendant raises the cover; the Grand Commandant pours the second libation, advances before the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, kneels facing north, sets down the goblet, rises, and bows twice.

units.zh: 詣配帝犧尊所，取爵於坫，酌醴齊，進高祖神堯皇帝前，東向跪，奠爵，興，再拜。
units.en: He goes to the associated deity's sacrificial vessel, takes a goblet from the stand, pours the second libation, advances before Emperor Gaozu the Divine Progenitor, kneels facing east, sets down the goblet, rises, and bows twice.
units.literal: He proceeds to the sacrificial vessel position for the associated deity, takes a goblet from the stand, pours the second libation, advances before Emperor Gaozu the Divine Progenitor, kneels facing east, sets down the goblet, rises, and bows twice.

units.zh: 進昊天上帝前，北向立。
units.en: He again advances before the August Supreme Lord of Heaven and stands facing north.
units.literal: He advances before the August Supreme Lord of Heaven and stands facing north.

units.zh: 諸太祝各以爵酌福酒，合置一爵，進于右，西向立。
units.en: Each Chief Invoker pours blessed wine into one goblet, advances it to the right, and stands facing west.
units.literal: Each Chief Invoker pours blessed wine with a goblet; they combine it in one goblet and advance it to the right; they stand facing west.

units.zh: 太尉再拜，受爵，跪，祭酒，遂飲，卒爵。
units.en: The Grand Commandant bows twice, receives the goblet, kneels, offers a libation, drinks, and finishes it.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant bows twice, receives the goblet, kneels, offers a libation, then drinks and finishes the goblet.

units.zh: 太祝進受虛爵，復於坫。
units.en: The Chief Invoker receives the empty goblet and returns it to the stand.
units.literal: The Chief Invoker advances to receive the empty goblet and returns it to the stand.

units.zh: 太尉再拜，降，復位。
units.en: The Grand Commandant bows twice, descends, and returns to his station.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant bows twice, descends, and returns to his position.

units.zh: 初，太尉獻將畢，謁者引光祿卿詣罍洗，盥手，洗瓠爵，升，酌盎齊。
units.en: When the Grand Commandant's offering is nearly complete, an usher leads the Director of the Imperial Household to the washing urn. He washes his hands, rinses the gourd goblet, ascends, and pours the third libation.
units.literal: At first, when the Grand Commandant's offering is nearly complete, the usher leads the Director of the Imperial Household to the washing urn; he washes his hands, rinses the gourd goblet, ascends, and pours the third libation.

units.zh: 終獻如亞獻。
units.en: The final offering follows the same procedure as the secondary offering.
units.literal: The final offering follows the secondary offering.

units.zh: 太尉將升獻，謁者七人分引五方帝及大明、夜明等獻官，詣罍洗，盥手，洗瓠爵，各由其陛升，酌汎齊，進，跪奠於神前。
units.en: When the Grand Commandant is about to offer, seven ushers lead the offering officers for the Five Directional Emperors, the Bright Luminary, the Night Luminary, and the like to the washing urn. They wash their hands, rinse gourd goblets, ascend by their respective steps, pour the first libation, advance, kneel, and set offerings before the spirits.
units.literal: When the Grand Commandant is about to ascend to offer, seven ushers in turn lead the offering officers for the Five Directional Emperors, the Bright Luminary, the Night Luminary, and the like to the washing urn; they wash their hands, rinse gourd goblets, each ascend by his steps, pour the first libation, advance, kneel, and set offerings before the spirits.

units.zh: 初，第一等獻官將升，謁者五人次引獻官各詣罍洗，盥、洗，各由其陛升壇，詣第二等內官酒尊所，酌汎齊以獻。
units.en: When first-rank offering officers are about to ascend, five ushers in succession lead each to the washing urn. Each ascends by his steps to the second-rank inner officials' wine vessels and pours the first libation as an offering.
units.literal: At first, when first-rank offering officers are about to ascend, five ushers in succession lead each offering officer to the washing urn to wash; each ascends the altar by his steps to the wine vessel positions for second-rank inner officials and pours the first libation to offer.

units.zh: 贊者四人次引獻官詣罍洗，盥、洗，詣外官酒尊所，酌清酒以獻。
units.en: Four presenters in succession lead offering officers to wash, then to the outer officials' wine vessels to pour clear wine as offerings.
units.literal: Four presenters in succession lead offering officers to the washing urn to wash, then to the wine vessel positions for outer officials and pour clear wine to offer.

units.zh: 贊者四人，次引獻官詣罍洗，盥、洗，詣眾星酒尊所，酌昔酒以獻。
units.en: Four presenters next lead offering officers to wash, then to the host of stars' wine vessels to pour aged wine as offerings.
units.literal: Four presenters next lead offering officers to the washing urn to wash, then to the wine vessel positions for the host of stars and pour aged wine to offer.

units.zh: 其祝史、齋郎酌酒助奠，皆如內官。
units.en: Invokers and purification youths who pour wine to assist in presentation follow the same procedure as the inner officials.
units.literal: Invokers and purification youths who pour wine to assist in presentation all follow the inner officials.

units.zh: 上下諸祝各進，跪徹豆，還尊所。
units.en: Invokers above and below advance, kneel, remove the beans, and return to the vessel positions.
units.literal: Invokers above and below each advance, kneel, remove the beans, and return to the vessel positions.

units.zh: 奉禮郎曰：「賜胙。」
units.en: The Master of Ceremonies announces: "Bestow the sacrificial flesh."
units.literal: The Master of Ceremonies says: "Bestow the sacrificial flesh."

units.zh: 贊者曰：「眾官再拜。」
units.en: The presenter announces: "All officials bow twice."
units.literal: The presenter says: "All officials bow twice."

units.zh: 在位者皆再拜。
units.en: Everyone in position bows twice.
units.literal: All those in position bow twice.

units.zh: 太常卿前奏：「請再拜。」
units.en: The Director of Imperial Sacrifices advances and announces: "Please bow twice."
units.literal: The Director of the Imperial Sacrifices advances and announces: "Please bow twice."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜。
units.en: The emperor bows twice.
units.literal: The emperor bows twice.

units.zh: 奉禮郎曰：「眾官再拜。」
units.en: The Master of Ceremonies announces: "All officials bow twice."
units.literal: The Master of Ceremonies says: "All officials bow twice."

units.zh: 在位者皆再拜。
units.en: Everyone in position bows twice.
units.literal: All those in position bow twice.

units.zh: 樂作一成。
units.en: One movement of music is performed.
units.literal: Music performs one movement.

units.zh: 太常卿前奏：「請就望燎位。」
units.en: The Director of Imperial Sacrifices advances and announces: "Please take the position for gazing at the fire-offering."
units.literal: The Director of the Imperial Sacrifices advances and announces: "Please take the position for gazing at the fire-offering."

units.zh: 皇帝就位，南向立。
units.en: The emperor takes position and stands facing south.
units.literal: The emperor takes his position and stands facing south.

units.zh: 上下諸祝各執篚，取玉、幣、祝版、禮物以上。
units.en: Invokers above and below each take baskets, gather jade, silks, prayer boards, and ritual gifts, and ascend.
units.literal: Invokers above and below each hold baskets, take up jade, silks, prayer boards, and ritual gifts, and ascend.

units.zh: 齋郎以俎載牲體、稷、黍飯及爵酒，各由其陛降壇，詣柴壇，自南陛登，以幣、祝版、饌物置於柴上。
units.en: Purification youths load trays with victim portions, millet and glutinous rice, and goblets of wine. Each descends by his steps, goes to the firewood altar, ascends the southern steps, and places silks, prayer boards, and offerings on the firewood.
units.literal: Purification youths load trays with victim portions, millet and glutinous millet rice, and goblets of wine; each descends the altar by his steps, proceeds to the firewood altar, ascends the southern steps, and places silks, prayer boards, and offerings on the firewood.

units.zh: 戶內諸祝又以內官以下禮幣皆從燎。
units.en: Inner-chamber invokers also send ritual silks for inner officials and below to be burned together.
units.literal: Inner-chamber invokers also send ritual silks for inner officials and below to the fire together.

units.zh: 奉禮郎曰：「可燎。」
units.en: The Master of Ceremonies announces: "The fire may be lit."
units.literal: The Master of Ceremonies says: "The fire may be lit."

units.zh: 東。
units.en: On the east and
units.literal: On the east and

units.zh: 西面各六人，以炬燎火。
units.en: west sides, six people on each side light the fire with torches.
units.literal: west sides, six persons on each side light the fire with torches.

units.zh: 半柴，太常卿前曰：「禮畢。」
units.en: When half the firewood is consumed, the Director of Imperial Sacrifices advances and says: "The rite is complete."
units.literal: When half the firewood is consumed, the Director of the Imperial Sacrifices advances and says: "The rite is complete."

units.zh: 皇帝還大次，出中壝門，殿中監前受鎮珪，以授尚衣奉御，殿中監又前受大珪。
units.en: The emperor returns to the great tent and exits the middle enclosure gate. The Palace Director receives the securing tablet and hands it to the Imperial Wardrobe Attendant, then receives the great tablet.
units.literal: The emperor returns to the great tent, exits the middle enclosure gate; the Palace Director advances to receive the securing tablet and hands it to the Imperial Wardrobe Attendant; the Palace Director again advances to receive the great tablet.

units.zh: 皇帝入次，謁者、贊引各引祀官，通事舍人分引從祀羣官、諸方客使以次出。
units.en: The emperor enters the tent. Ushers and presenters lead the sacrifice officers; the Communications Officer leads attending officials, those accompanying the sacrifice, and regional envoys out in order.
units.literal: The emperor enters the tent; ushers and presenters each lead sacrifice officers; the Communications Officer leads attending officials, officials accompanying the sacrifice, and envoys from the regions to exit in order.

units.zh: 贊者引御史、太祝以下俱復執事位。
units.en: The presenter leads censors, Chief Invokers, and those below back to their service positions.
units.literal: The presenter leads censors, Chief Invokers, and those below back together to their service positions.

units.zh: 奉禮郎曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The Master of Ceremonies announces: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The Master of Ceremonies says: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 御史以下皆再拜，出。
units.en: Censors and below all bow twice and exit.
units.literal: Censors and below all bow twice and exit.

units.zh: 工人、二舞以次出。
units.en: Craftsmen and the two dances leave in order.
units.literal: Craftsmen and the two dances exit in order.

units.zh: 若宗廟，曰饋食。
units.en: At the ancestral temple, this stage is called presenting food.
units.literal: At the ancestral temple, it is called presenting food.

units.zh: 皇帝既升，祼，太官令出，帥進饌者奉饌，陳於東門之外，西向南上。
units.en: After the emperor has ascended and performed the libation, the Imperial Kitchen Director leads food-bearers with offerings, arrayed outside the eastern gate, facing west with south ascending priority.
units.literal: After the emperor has ascended and performed the libation, the Imperial Kitchen Director goes out and leads food-bearers bearing offerings, arrayed outside the eastern gate, west-facing, south ascending.

units.zh: 謁者引司徒出，詣饌所，司徒奉獻祖之俎。
units.en: An usher leads the Minister over Masses to the offering station, where he bears the tray for the Offering Ancestor.
units.literal: The usher leads the Minister over Masses out to the offering station; the Minister over Masses bears the tray for the Offering Ancestor.

units.zh: 太官引饌入自正門，至於太階。
units.en: The Imperial Kitchen Director leads the offerings in through the main gate to the great steps.
units.literal: The Imperial Kitchen Director leads the offerings in through the main gate to the great steps.

units.zh: 祝史俱進，徹毛血之豆，降自阼階以出。
units.en: The invokers advance together, remove the hair-and-blood beans, and descend the eastern steps to exit.
units.literal: Invokers all advance together and remove the hair-and-blood beans, descending the eastern steps to exit.

units.zh: 諸太祝迎饌於階上設之，乃取蕭、稷、黍擩於脂，燔於爐。
units.en: The Chief Invokers receive the offerings on the steps and set them out, then take artemisia, millet, and glutinous millet, knead them in fat, and burn them on the furnace.
units.literal: The various Chief Invokers receive the offerings on the steps and set them out; they then take artemisia, millet, and glutinous millet, knead them in fat, and burn them on the furnace.

units.zh: 太常卿引皇帝詣罍洗，盥手，洗爵，升自阼階，詣獻祖尊彝所，執尊者舉冪，侍中贊酌汎齊，進獻祖前，北向跪，奠爵。
units.en: The Director of Imperial Sacrifices leads the emperor to the washing urn. He washes his hands, rinses the goblet, ascends the eastern steps, and goes to the Offering Ancestor's ritual vessel. The attendant raises the cover; the Palace Attendant intones as he pours the first libation and advances before the Offering Ancestor. He kneels facing north and sets down the goblet.
units.literal: The Director of the Imperial Sacrifices leads the emperor to the washing urn; he washes his hands, rinses the goblet, ascends the eastern steps, proceeds to the ritual vessel position for the Offering Ancestor; the vessel attendant raises the cover; the Palace Attendant intones as he pours the first libation and advances before the Offering Ancestor; he kneels facing north and sets down the goblet.

units.zh: 又詣尊所，侍中取爵於坫以進，酌汎齊，進神前，北向跪，奠爵，退立。
units.en: He again goes to the vessel position; the Palace Attendant takes a goblet from the stand, pours the first libation, advances before the spirit, kneels facing north, sets down the goblet, and withdraws to stand.
units.literal: He again proceeds to the vessel position; the Palace Attendant takes a goblet from the stand and advances it, pours the first libation, advances before the spirit, kneels facing north, sets down the goblet, and withdraws to stand.

units.zh: 太祝持版進於神右，東面跪，讀祝文曰：「維某年歲次月朔日，孝曾孫開元神武皇帝某，敢昭告于獻祖宣皇帝、祖妣宣莊皇后張氏。」
units.en: The Chief Invoker advances with the board to the spirit's right, kneels facing east, and reads: "In the year ___, on the ___ day of the first month, the filial great-grandson, the Kaiyuan Divine Martial Emperor ___, ventures to announce to the Offering Ancestor Emperor Xuan and the ancestress Empress Xuanzhuang of the Zhang clan."
units.literal: The Chief Invoker advances with the board to the right of the spirit, kneels facing east, and reads the prayer text: "In such-and-such a year, on such-and-such a day of the first month, the filial great-grandson, the Kaiyuan Divine Martial Emperor so-and-so, ventures to announce to the Offering Ancestor Emperor Xuan and the ancestress Empress Xuanzhuang of the Zhang clan."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜，又再拜。
units.en: The emperor bows twice, then twice again.
units.literal: The emperor bows twice, and again twice.

units.zh: 奠，詣懿祖尊彝，酌汎齊，進神前，南向跪，奠爵，少西，俛伏，興。
units.en: Having presented the offering, he goes to the Accomplished Ancestor's ritual vessel, pours the first libation, advances before the spirit, kneels facing south, sets down the goblet slightly to the west, prostrates, and rises.
units.literal: Having presented the offering, he proceeds to the ritual vessel position for the Accomplished Ancestor, pours the first libation, advances before the spirit, kneels facing south, sets down the goblet, slightly to the west, prostrates, and rises.

units.zh: 又酌汎齊，進神前，南向跪，爵，少東，退立。
units.en: He again pours the first libation, advances before the spirit, kneels facing south, sets down the goblet slightly to the east, and withdraws to stand.
units.literal: He again pours the first libation, advances before the spirit, kneels facing south, sets down the goblet, slightly to the east, and withdraws to stand.

units.zh: 祝史西面跪，讀祝文。
units.en: The invoker kneels facing west and reads the prayer.
units.literal: The invoker kneels facing west and reads the prayer text.

units.zh: 皇帝再拜，又再拜。
units.en: The emperor bows twice, then twice again.
units.literal: The emperor bows twice, and again twice.

units.zh: 次奠太祖、代祖、高祖、太宗、高宗、中宗、睿宗，皆如懿祖。
units.en: Next he presents offerings to the Great Ancestor, Replaced Ancestor, High Ancestor, Taizong, Gaozong, Zhongzong, and Ruizong, all following the Accomplished Ancestor's procedure.
units.literal: Next he presents offerings to the Great Ancestor, the Replaced Ancestor, the High Ancestor, Taizong, Gaozong, Zhongzong, and Ruizong, all as at the Accomplished Ancestor.

units.zh: 乃詣東序，西向立。
units.en: He then goes to the eastern sequence and stands facing west.
units.literal: He then proceeds to the eastern sequence and stands facing west.

units.zh: 司徒升自阼階，立於前楹間，北面東上。
units.en: The Minister over Masses ascends the eastern steps and stands between the front pillars, facing north with east ascending priority.
units.literal: The Minister over Masses ascends the eastern steps and stands between the front pillars, facing north with east ascending priority.

units.zh: 諸太祝各以爵酌上尊福酒，合置一爵，太祝持爵授侍中以進。
units.en: Each Chief Invoker pours blessed wine from the upper vessel into one goblet; the Chief Invoker gives it to the Palace Attendant to present.
units.literal: Each Chief Invoker pours blessed wine from the upper vessel with a goblet; they combine it in one goblet; the Chief Invoker presents the goblet to the Palace Attendant to advance.

units.zh: 皇帝再拜，受爵，跪，祭酒，啐酒，奠爵，俛伏，興。
units.en: The emperor bows twice, receives the goblet, kneels, offers a libation, sips the wine, sets down the goblet, prostrates, and rises.
units.literal: The emperor bows twice, receives the goblet, kneels, offers a libation, sips the wine, sets down the goblet, prostrates, and rises.

units.zh: 諸太祝各帥齋郎進俎，太祝減神前三牲胙肉，共置一俎上，以黍、稷飯共置一籩，授司徒以進；
units.en: Each Chief Invoker leads purification youths to advance the trays. The Chief Invokers cut the three-sacrifice flesh before the spirits, place it on one tray, place millet and glutinous rice together on one bian, and present them through the Minister over Masses;
units.literal: Each Chief Invoker leads purification youths to advance the trays; the Chief Invokers cut the three-sacrifice flesh before the spirits, place it together on one tray, place millet and glutinous millet rice together on one bian, and present them through the Minister over Masses;

units.zh: 太祝又以胙肉授司徒以進。
units.en: the Chief Invoker again presents sacrificial flesh through the Minister over Masses.
units.literal: the Chief Invoker again presents sacrificial flesh through the Minister over Masses to advance.

units.zh: 皇帝每受，以授左右，乃跪取爵，飲，卒爵。
units.en: Each time the emperor receives an offering he hands it to his attendants, then kneels, takes the goblet, drinks, and finishes it.
units.literal: Each time the emperor receives an offering he hands it to attendants at his sides, then kneels, takes the goblet, drinks, and finishes the goblet.

units.zh: 侍中進受虛爵，以授太祝，復於坫。
units.en: The Palace Attendant receives the empty goblet and hands it to the Chief Invoker, who returns it to the stand.
units.literal: The Palace Attendant advances to receive the empty goblet and hands it to the Chief Invoker, who returns it to the stand.

units.zh: 皇帝降自阼階，復于版位。
units.en: The emperor descends the eastern steps and returns to his designated ceremonial station.
units.literal: The emperor descends the eastern steps and returns to the position marked by his ceremonial tablet.

units.zh: 文舞出，武舞入。
units.en: The civil dance exits and the military dance enters.
units.literal: The civil dance exits; the military dance enters.

units.zh: 初，皇帝將復位，太尉詣罍洗，盥手，洗爵，升自阼階，詣獻祖尊彝所，酌醴齊進神前，北向跪，奠爵；
units.en: When the emperor is about to return to his position, the Grand Commandant goes to the washing urn, washes his hands, rinses the goblet, ascends the eastern steps, and goes to the Offering Ancestor's ritual vessel. He pours the second libation, advances before the spirit, kneels facing north, and sets down the goblet;
units.literal: At first, as the emperor is about to return to his position, the Grand Commandant proceeds to the washing urn, washes his hands, rinses the goblet, ascends the eastern steps, proceeds to the ritual vessel position for the Offering Ancestor, pours the second libation and advances before the spirit, kneels facing north, and sets down the goblet;

units.zh: 少東，興，再拜。
units.en: slightly to the east, rises, and bows twice.
units.literal: slightly to the east, he rises and bows twice.

units.zh: 又取爵於坫，酌醴齊進神前，北向跪，奠爵；
units.en: He again takes a goblet from the stand, pours the second libation, advances before the spirit, kneels facing north, and sets down the goblet;
units.literal: He again takes a goblet from the stand, pours the second libation, advances before the spirit, kneels facing north, and sets down the goblet;

units.zh: 少西，北向再拜。
units.en: slightly to the west, and bows twice facing north.
units.literal: slightly to the west, he bows twice facing north.

units.zh: 次奠懿祖、太祖、代祖、高祖、太宗、高宗、中宗、睿宗如獻祖。
units.en: Next he presents offerings to the Accomplished Ancestor, Great Ancestor, Replaced Ancestor, High Ancestor, Taizong, Gaozong, Zhongzong, and Ruizong as at the Offering Ancestor.
units.literal: Next he presents offerings to the Accomplished Ancestor, Great Ancestor, Replaced Ancestor, High Ancestor, Taizong, Gaozong, Zhongzong, and Ruizong as at the Offering Ancestor.

units.zh: 乃詣東序，西向立。
units.en: He then goes to the eastern sequence and stands facing west.
units.literal: He then proceeds to the eastern sequence and stands facing west.

units.zh: 諸太祝各以爵酌福酒，合置一爵，太祝持爵進於左，北向立。
units.en: Each Chief Invoker pours blessed wine into one goblet; the Chief Invoker advances with it to the left and stands facing north.
units.literal: Each Chief Invoker pours blessed wine with a goblet; they combine it in one goblet; the Chief Invoker advances with the goblet to the left and stands facing north.

units.zh: 太尉再拜受爵，跪，祭酒，遂飲，卒爵。
units.en: The Grand Commandant bows twice, receives the goblet, kneels, offers a libation, drinks, and finishes it.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant bows twice, receives the goblet, kneels, offers a libation, then drinks and finishes the goblet.

units.zh: 太祝進受爵，復於坫。
units.en: The Chief Invoker receives the goblet and returns it to the stand.
units.literal: The Chief Invoker advances to receive the goblet and returns it to the stand.

units.zh: 太尉興，再拜，復于位。
units.en: The Grand Commandant rises, bows twice, and returns to his station.
units.literal: The Grand Commandant rises, bows twice, and returns to his position.

units.zh: 初，太尉獻將畢，謁者引光祿卿詣罍洗，盥、洗，升，酌盎齊。
units.en: When the Grand Commandant's offering is nearly complete, an usher leads the Director of the Imperial Household to wash, ascend, and pour the third libation.
units.literal: At first, when the Grand Commandant's offering is nearly complete, the usher leads the Director of the Imperial Household to the washing urn to wash, ascends, and pours the third libation.

units.zh: 終獻如亞獻。
units.en: The final offering follows the same procedure as the secondary offering.
units.literal: The final offering follows the secondary offering.

units.zh: 諸太祝各進，徹豆，還尊所。
units.en: Each Chief Invoker advances, removes the beans, and returns to the vessel position.
units.literal: Each Chief Invoker advances, removes the beans, and returns to the vessel position.

units.zh: 奉禮郎曰：「賜胙。」
units.en: The Master of Ceremonies says: "Bestow the sacrificial flesh."
units.literal: The Master of Ceremonies says: "Bestow the sacrificial flesh."

units.zh: 贊者曰：「眾官再拜。」
units.en: The presenter says: "All officials bow twice."
units.literal: The presenter says: "All officials bow twice."

units.zh: 在位者皆再拜。
units.en: All those in position bow twice.
units.literal: All those in position bow twice.

units.zh: 太常卿前奏：「請再拜。」
units.en: The Director of Imperial Sacrifices advances and announces: "Please bow twice."
units.literal: The Director of the Imperial Sacrifices advances and announces: "Please bow twice."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜。
units.en: The emperor bows twice.
units.literal: The emperor bows twice.

units.zh: 奉禮郎曰：「眾官再拜。」
units.en: The Master of Ceremonies says: "All officials bow twice."
units.literal: The Master of Ceremonies says: "All officials bow twice."

units.zh: 在位者皆再拜。
units.en: All those in position bow twice.
units.literal: All those in position bow twice.

units.zh: 樂一成止。
units.en: When one movement of music is complete, it stops.
units.literal: When one movement of music is complete, it stops.

units.zh: 太常卿前曰：「禮畢。」
units.en: The Director of Imperial Sacrifices advances and says: "The rite is complete."
units.literal: The Director of the Imperial Sacrifices advances and says: "The rite is complete."

units.zh: 皇帝出門，殿中監前受鎮珪。
units.en: The emperor exits the gate; the Palace Director receives the securing tablet.
units.literal: The emperor exits the gate; the Palace Director advances to receive the securing tablet.

units.zh: 通事舍人、謁者、贊引各引享官、九廟子孫及從享羣官、諸方客使以次出。
units.en: The Communications Officer, ushers, and presenters lead sacrifice officers, descendants of the nine temples, those accompanying the sacrifice, and regional envoys out in order.
units.literal: The Communications Officer, ushers, and presenters each lead sacrifice officers, descendants of the nine temples, officials accompanying the sacrifice, and envoys from the regions to exit in order.

units.zh: 贊引引御史、太祝以下俱復執事位。
units.en: The presenter leads censors, Chief Invokers, and those below back to their service positions.
units.literal: The presenter leads censors, Chief Invokers, and those below back together to their service positions.

units.zh: 奉禮郎曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The Master of Ceremonies says: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The Master of Ceremonies says: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 御史以下皆再拜以出。
units.en: Censors and below all bow twice as they exit.
units.literal: Censors and below all bow twice as they exit.

units.zh: 工人、二舞以次出。
units.en: Craftsmen and the two dances leave in order.
units.literal: Craftsmen and the two dances exit in order.

units.zh: 太廟令與太祝、宮闈令帥腰輿升，納神主。
units.en: The Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, with Chief Invokers and the Director of the Palace Inner Gates, lead the litter up and return the spirit tablets.
units.literal: The Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, together with Chief Invokers and the Director of the Palace Inner Gates, lead the litter up and return the spirit tablets.

units.zh: 其祝版燔於齋坊。
units.en: The prayer boards are burned in the purification lodge.
units.literal: The prayer boards are burned in the purification lodge.

units.zh: 七祀，各因其時享：司命、戶以春，竈以夏，中霤以季夏土王之日，門、厲以秋，行以冬。
units.en: The seven sacrifices are each offered in season: Director of Fate and Door in spring, Stove in summer, Central Court on the day when Earth is king in late summer, Gate and Pestilence in autumn, and Travel in winter.
units.literal: The seven sacrifices are each offered at their season: Director of Fate and Door in spring, Stove in summer, Central Court on the day when Earth is king in the last month of summer, Gate and Pestilence in autumn, and Travel in winter.

units.zh: 時享之日，太廟令布神席于廟庭西門之內道南，東向北上；
units.en: On the day of the seasonal offering, the Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple spreads spirit mats in the temple courtyard inside the western gate on the southern path, east-facing with north ascending priority;
units.literal: On the day of the seasonal offering, the Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple spreads spirit mats in the temple courtyard inside the western gate on the southern path, east-facing with north ascending priority;

units.zh: 設酒尊于東南，罍洗又於東南。
units.en: Wine vessels are set in the southeast, with the washing urn again in the southeast.
units.literal: wine vessels are set in the southeast, and the washing urn again in the southeast.

units.zh: 太廟令、良醞令實尊篚，太官丞引饌，光祿卿升，終獻，獻官乃即事，一獻而止。
units.en: The Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple and Director of Fine Wine fill vessels and baskets; the Imperial Kitchen Assistant leads offerings; the Director of the Imperial Household ascends for the final offering; offering officers then take up their duties with a single offering only.
units.literal: The Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple and Director of Fine Wine fill vessels and baskets; the Imperial Kitchen Assistant leads offerings; the Director of the Imperial Household ascends and makes the final offering; offering officers then take up their duties, with one offering only.

units.zh: 其配享功臣，各位於其廟室太階之東，少南西向，以北為上。
units.en: Meritorious ministers who share in the sacrifice stand east of the great steps of their temple chamber, slightly to the south, facing west, with north as ascending priority.
units.literal: Meritorious ministers who share in the sacrifice each take position east of the great steps of their temple chamber, slightly south, facing west, with north as ascending priority.

units.zh: 壺尊二於座左，設洗於終獻洗東南，北向。
units.en: Two jar vessels are placed to the left of the seat; a washing station is set southeast of the final-offering washing station, facing north.
units.literal: Two jar vessels are set left of the seat; a washing station is set southeast of the final-offering washing station, facing north.

units.zh: 以太官令奉饌，廟享已亞獻，然後獻官即事，而助奠者分奠，一獻而止。
units.en: The Imperial Kitchen Director presents offerings. After the temple sacrifice reaches the secondary offering, the offering officer takes up his duties, assistants present offerings separately, and only one offering is made.
units.literal: The Imperial Kitchen Director presents offerings; after the temple sacrifice has reached the secondary offering, the offering officer then takes up his duties, assistants present offerings separately, and one offering only.

units.zh: 此冬至祀昊天上帝于圓丘、孟冬祫于太廟之禮，在乎壇壝、宗廟之間，禮盛而物備者莫過乎此也。
units.en: These are the rites for sacrificing to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven at the Round Mound at the winter solstice and the collective offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple in early winter—among affairs between altar enclosures and ancestral temples, none surpasses these in ritual grandeur and completeness of installations.
units.literal: These are the rites for sacrificing to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven at the Round Mound at the winter solstice and the collective offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple in the first month of winter—among affairs between altar enclosures and ancestral temples, none surpasses these in ritual grandeur and completeness of installations.

units.zh: 其壇堂之上下、壝門之內外、次位之尊卑與其向立之方、出入降登之節，大抵可推而見，其盛且備者如此，則其小且略者又可推而知也。
units.en: The precedence above and below the altar hall, inside and outside the enclosure gates, the honor of secondary positions, the directions in which participants stand, and the stages of entering, exiting, ascending, and descending can largely be inferred; when the grand and complete are thus laid out, the lesser and abbreviated may also be inferred.
units.literal: The precedence above and below the altar hall, inside and outside the enclosure gates, the honor of secondary positions, the directions in which participants stand, and the stages of entering, exiting, ascending, and descending can largely be inferred from what is seen; when the grand and complete are thus, the lesser and abbreviated may also be inferred.

units.zh: 至於壇埳、神位、尊爵、玉幣、籩豆、簋簠、牲牢、冊祝之數皆略依古。
units.en: The numbers of altar pits, spirit positions, vessels and goblets, jade and silks, bian and dou, gui and fu, victims, and prayer boards all broadly follow antiquity.
units.literal: As for the numbers of altar pits, spirit positions, vessels and goblets, jade and silks, bian and dou, gui and fu, victims, and prayer boards—all broadly follow antiquity.

units.zh: 四成，而成高八尺一寸，下成廣二十丈，而五減之，至于五丈，而十有二陛者，圓丘也。
units.en: Four tiers, each eight feet one inch high, the lower tier twenty zhang wide and reduced by a fifth down to five zhang, with twelve steps—that is the Round Mound.
units.literal: Four tiers, each eight feet one inch high, the lower tier twenty zhang wide and reduced by a fifth down to five zhang, with twelve steps—the Round Mound.

units.zh: 八觚三成，成高四尺，上廣十有六步，設八陛，上陛廣八尺，中陛一丈，下陛丈有二尺者，方丘也。
units.en: Eight-faceted and three-tiered, each tier four feet high, the upper sixteen paces wide with eight steps—the upper steps eight feet wide, the middle ten feet, the lower twelve feet—that is the Square Mound.
units.literal: Eight-faceted, three tiers, each tier four feet high, the upper sixteen paces wide, with eight steps; the upper steps eight feet wide, the middle ten feet, the lower twelve feet—the Square Mound.

units.zh: 高、廣皆四丈者，神州之壇也。
units.en: Four zhang high and four zhang wide—that is the altar of the Spirit Land.
units.literal: Four zhang high and four zhang wide—the altar of the Spirit Land.

units.zh: 其廣皆四丈，而高八尺者青帝、七尺者赤帝、五尺者黃帝、九尺者白帝、六尺者黑帝之壇也。
units.en: All four zhang wide: eight feet high for the Green Emperor, seven for the Red, five for the Yellow, nine for the White, six for the Black—the altars of the Five Directional Emperors.
units.literal: All four zhang wide: eight feet high for the Green Emperor, seven for the Red Emperor, five for the Yellow Emperor, nine for the White Emperor, six for the Black Emperor—the altars of the Five Directional Emperors.

units.zh: 廣四丈，高八尺者，朝日之壇也。
units.en: Four zhang wide and eight feet high—that is the altar for the morning sun.
units.literal: Four zhang wide and eight feet high—the altar for the morning sun.

units.zh: 為坎深三尺，縱廣四丈，壇於其中，高一尺，方廣四丈者，夕月之壇也。
units.en: A pit three feet deep, four zhang long and wide, with an altar one foot high and four zhang square within—that is the altar for the evening moon.
units.literal: A pit three feet deep, four zhang long and wide, with an altar within one foot high and four zhang square—the altar for the evening moon.

units.zh: 廣五丈，以五土為之者，社稷之壇也。
units.en: Five zhang wide, made of the five soils—the altars of soil and grain.
units.literal: Five zhang wide, made of the five soils—the altars of the altars of soil and grain.

units.zh: 高尺，廣丈，蜡壇也。
units.en: One foot high and one zhang wide—the wax altar.
units.literal: One foot high and one zhang wide—the wax altar.

units.zh: 高五尺，周四十步者，先農、先蠶之壇也。
units.en: Five feet high and forty paces around—the altars of the First Farmer and First Silkworm.
units.literal: Five feet high and forty paces around—the altars of the First Farmer and First Silkworm.

units.zh: 其高皆三尺，廣皆丈者，小祀之壇也。
units.en: All three feet high and one zhang wide—the altars of minor sacrifices.
units.literal: All three feet high and one zhang wide—the altars of minor sacrifices.

units.zh: 嶽鎮、海瀆祭於其廟，無廟則為之壇於坎，廣一丈，四向為陛者，海瀆之壇也。
units.en: Mountains, garrisons, seas, and rivers are sacrificed at their temples; where there is no temple, an altar is made in a pit one zhang wide with steps on four sides—the altar for seas and rivers.
units.literal: Mountains, garrisons, seas, and rivers are sacrificed at their temples; where there is no temple, an altar is made in a pit, one zhang wide, with steps on four sides facing outward—the altar for seas and rivers.

units.zh: 廣二丈五尺，高三尺，四出陛者，古帝王之壇也。
units.en: Two zhang five feet wide, three feet high, with steps on four sides—the altars of ancient emperors.
units.literal: Two zhang five feet wide, three feet high, with steps on four sides—the altars of ancient emperors.

units.zh: 廣一丈，高一丈二尺，戶方六尺者，大祀之燎壇也。
units.en: One zhang wide, twelve feet high, with a doorway six feet square—the fire altar for great sacrifices.
units.literal: One zhang wide, twelve feet high, with a doorway six feet square—the fire altar for great sacrifices.

units.zh: 廣八尺，高一丈，戶方三尺者，中祀之燎壇也。
units.en: Eight feet wide, ten feet high, with a doorway three feet square—the fire altar for middle sacrifices.
units.literal: Eight feet wide, ten feet high, with a doorway three feet square—the fire altar for middle sacrifices.

units.zh: 廣五尺，戶方二尺者，小祀之燎壇也。
units.en: Five feet wide, with a doorway two feet square—the fire altar for minor sacrifices.
units.literal: Five feet wide, with a doorway two feet square—the fire altar for minor sacrifices.

units.zh: 皆開上南出。
units.en: All open at the top, with the opening facing south.
units.literal: All open at the top with the opening facing south.

units.zh: 瘞坎皆在內壝之外壬地，南出陛，方深足容物。
units.en: Burial pits are all outside the inner enclosure in the ren position, with steps facing south, square and deep enough to hold the offerings.
units.literal: Burial pits are all outside the inner enclosure in the ren position, with steps facing south, square and deep enough to hold the offerings.

units.zh: 此壇埳之制也。
units.en: These are the regulations governing altar pits.
units.literal: These are the regulations for altar pits.

units.zh: 冬至祀昊天上帝於圓丘，以高祖神堯皇帝配。
units.en: At the winter solstice, sacrifice to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven at the Round Mound, with Emperor Gaozu, the Divine Yao Emperor, as associated recipient.
units.literal: At the winter solstice, sacrifice to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven at the Round Mound, with Emperor Gaozu, the Divine Yao Emperor, as associated recipient.

units.zh: 東方青帝靈威仰、南方赤帝赤熛怒、中央黃帝含樞紐、西方白帝白招拒、北方黑帝汁光紀及大明、夜明在壇之第一等。
units.en: The Green Emperor of the East, Spiritual Might and Regard; the Red Emperor of the South, Red Blaze and Wrath; the Yellow Emperor of the Center, Holding the Pivot; the White Emperor of the West, White Summons and Rejection; the Black Emperor of the North, Juice of Light and Record; together with the Bright Luminary and Night Luminary on the altar's first tier.
units.literal: The Green Emperor of the East, Spiritual Might and Regard; the Red Emperor of the South, Red Blaze and Wrath; the Yellow Emperor of the Center, Holding the Pivot; the White Emperor of the West, White Summons and Rejection; the Black Emperor of the North, Juice of Light and Record; together with the Bright Luminary and Night Luminary on the first tier of the altar.

units.zh: 天皇大帝、北辰、北斗、天一、太一、紫微五帝座，並差在行位前。
units.en: The Celestial Emperor, North Star, Big Dipper, Celestial One, Supreme One, and the Five Emperors' seats of Purple Tenuity are all placed in front of the regular rows.
units.literal: The Celestial Emperor, North Star, Big Dipper, Celestial One, Supreme One, and the Five Emperors' seats of Purple Tenuity are all placed in front of the regular rows.

units.zh: 餘內官諸坐及五星、十二辰、河漢四十九坐，在第二等十有二陛之間。
units.en: The remaining inner-official seats, the Five Stars, twelve chronograms, and forty-nine seats of the River Han are on the second tier among the twelve steps.
units.literal: The remaining inner-official seats, the Five Stars, twelve chronograms, and forty-nine seats of the River Han are on the second tier among the twelve steps.

units.zh: 中官、市垣、帝座、七公、日星、帝席、大角、攝提、太微、五帝、太子、明堂、軒轅、三台、五車、諸王、月星、織女、建星、天紀十七座及二十八宿，差在前列。
units.en: Central Palace, Market Enclosure, Imperial Seat, Seven Dukes, Sun Star, Imperial Couch, Great Horn, Sombre Establishment, Supreme Palace, Five Emperors, Crown Prince, Bright Hall, Chariot Axis, Three Terraces, Five Chariots, Various Kings, Moon Star, Weaver Girl, Establishment Star, Celestial Record—seventeen seats and the twenty-eight lodges—are ranked in the front row.
units.literal: Central Palace, Market Enclosure, Imperial Seat, Seven Dukes, Sun Star, Imperial Couch, Great Horn, Sombre Establishment, Supreme Palace, Five Emperors, Crown Prince, Bright Hall, Chariot Axis, Three Terraces, Five Chariots, Various Kings, Moon Star, Weaver Girl, Establishment Star, Celestial Record—seventeen seats and the twenty-eight lodges—are ranked in the front row.

units.zh: 其餘中官一百四十二座皆在第三等十二陛之間。
units.en: The remaining one hundred forty-two central-official seats are all on the third tier among the twelve steps.
units.literal: The remaining one hundred forty-two central-official seats are all on the third tier among the twelve steps.

units.zh: 外官一百五在內壝之內，眾星三百六十在內壝之外。
units.en: One hundred five outer officials are within the inner enclosure; three hundred sixty host stars are outside it.
units.literal: One hundred five outer officials are within the inner enclosure; three hundred sixty host stars are outside the inner enclosure.

units.zh: 正月上辛祈穀祀昊天上帝，以高祖神堯皇帝配，五帝在四方之陛。
units.en: On the first xin day of the first month, at the prayer-for-grain sacrifice to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, Emperor Gaozu, the Divine Yao Emperor, serves as associated recipient; the Five Emperors occupy the steps in the four directions.
units.literal: On the first xin day of the first month, at the prayer-for-grain sacrifice to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, Emperor Gaozu, the Divine Yao Emperor, serves as associated recipient; the Five Emperors occupy the steps in the four directions.

units.zh: 孟夏雩祀昊天上帝，以太宗文武聖皇帝配，五方帝在第一等，五帝在第二等，五官在壇下之東南。
units.en: In the first month of summer, rain sacrifice to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, with Taizong the Civil and Martial Sagely Emperor as associated deity; the Five Directional Emperors on the first tier, the Five Emperors on the second, the Five Officials southeast below the altar.
units.literal: In the first month of summer, rain sacrifice to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, with Taizong the Civil and Martial Sagely Emperor as associated deity; the Five Directional Emperors on the first tier, the Five Emperors on the second, the Five Officials southeast below the altar.

units.zh: 季秋祀昊天上帝，以睿宗大聖真皇帝配，五方帝在五室，五帝各在其左，五官在庭，各依其方。
units.en: In the last month of autumn, sacrifice to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, with Ruizong the Great Sagely True Emperor as associated deity; the Five Directional Emperors in the five chambers, each Five Emperor to his left, the Five Officials in the courtyard each according to his direction.
units.literal: In the last month of autumn, sacrifice to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, with Ruizong the Great Sagely True Emperor as associated deity; the Five Directional Emperors in the five chambers, each Five Emperor to his left, the Five Officials in the courtyard each according to his direction.

units.zh: 立春祀青帝，以太皥氏配，歲星、三辰在壇下之東北，七宿在西北，句芒在東南。
units.en: At the beginning of spring, sacrifice to the Green Emperor, with the Great Bright One as associated deity; the Year Star and three chronograms below the altar in the northeast, seven lodges in the northwest, Goumang in the southeast.
units.literal: At the beginning of spring, sacrifice to the Green Emperor, with the Great Bright One as associated deity; the Year Star and three chronograms below the altar in the northeast, seven lodges in the northwest, Goumang in the southeast.

units.zh: 立夏祀赤帝，以神農氏配，熒惑、三辰、七宿、祝融氏之位如青帝。
units.en: At the beginning of summer, sacrifice to the Red Emperor, with the Divine Farmer as associated deity; Sparkling Deluder, three chronograms, seven lodges, and Zhurong are positioned as for the Green Emperor.
units.literal: At the beginning of summer, sacrifice to the Red Emperor, with the Divine Farmer as associated deity; the positions of Sparkling Deluder, three chronograms, seven lodges, and Zhurong are as for the Green Emperor.

units.zh: 季夏土王之日祀黃帝，以軒轅氏配，鎮星、后土氏之位如赤帝。
units.en: On the day when Earth is king in late summer, sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor, with Xuanyuan as associated deity; the Queller Star and Queen Earth are positioned as for the Red Emperor.
units.literal: On the day when Earth is king in the last month of summer, sacrifice to the Yellow Emperor, with Xuanyuan as associated deity; the positions of the Queller Star and Queen Earth are as for the Red Emperor.

units.zh: 立秋祀白帝，以少昊氏配，太白、三辰、七宿、蓐收之位如赤帝。
units.en: At the beginning of autumn, sacrifice to the White Emperor, with the Lesser Bright One as associated deity; Great White, three chronograms, seven lodges, and Rushou are positioned as for the Red Emperor.
units.literal: At the beginning of autumn, sacrifice to the White Emperor, with the Lesser Bright One as associated deity; Great White, three chronograms, seven lodges, and Rushou are as for the Red Emperor.

units.zh: 立冬祀黑帝，以顓頊氏配，辰星、三辰、七宿、玄冥氏之位如白帝。
units.en: At the beginning of winter, sacrifice to the Black Emperor, with Zhuanxu as associated deity; Chronogram Star, three chronograms, seven lodges, and Dark Ming are positioned as for the White Emperor.
units.literal: At the beginning of winter, sacrifice to the Black Emperor, with Zhuanxu as associated deity; Chronogram Star, three chronograms, seven lodges, and Dark Ming are as for the White Emperor.

units.zh: 蜡祭百神，大明、夜明在壇上，神農、伊耆各在其壇上，后稷在壇東，五官、田畯各在其方，五星、十二次、二十八宿、五方之岳鎮、海瀆、山林、川澤、丘陵、墳衍、原隰、井泉各在其方之壇，龍、麟、朱鳥、騶虞、玄武、鱗、羽、臝、毛、介、水墉、坊、郵表畷、於菟、貓各在其方壇之後。
units.en: At the wax sacrifice to the hundred spirits, the Bright Luminary and Night Luminary are on the altar; the Divine Farmer and Yiyi each on his altar; Houji east of the altar; the Five Officials and field directors each in his direction; the Five Stars, twelve chronograms, twenty-eight lodges, directional mountains and garrisons, seas and rivers, mountains, forests, rivers, marshes, hills, mounds, plains, wetlands, and wells and springs each on altars in his direction; dragon, unicorn, vermilion bird, zouyu, dark warrior, scaled, feathered, naked, furred, shelled, water embankments, wards, postal markers, watch huts, yutu (tiger), and cat each behind altars in his direction.
units.literal: At the wax sacrifice to the hundred spirits, the Bright Luminary and Night Luminary are on the altar; the Divine Farmer and Yiyi each on his altar; Houji east of the altar; the Five Officials and field directors each in his direction; the Five Stars, twelve chronograms, twenty-eight lodges, directional mountains and garrisons, seas and rivers, mountains, forests, rivers, marshes, hills, mounds, plains, wetlands, wells and springs each on altars in his direction; dragon, unicorn, vermilion bird, zouyu, dark warrior, scaled, feathered, naked, furred, shelled, water embankments, wards, postal markers, watch huts, yutu (tiger), and cat each behind altars in his direction.

units.zh: 夏至祭皇地祇，以高祖配，五方之岳鎮、海瀆、原隰、丘陵、墳衍在內壝之內，各居其方，而中岳以下在西南。
units.en: At the summer solstice, sacrifice to the August Earth Lord, with the High Ancestor as associated deity; directional mountains and garrisons, seas and rivers, plains, wetlands, hills, mounds, and plains and marshes are within the inner enclosure each in his direction, while below the central mountain they are in the southwest.
units.literal: At the summer solstice, sacrifice to the August Earth Lord, with the High Ancestor as associated deity; directional mountains and garrisons, seas and rivers, plains, wetlands, hills, mounds, and plains and marshes are within the inner enclosure, each in his direction, while below the central mountain they are in the southwest.

units.zh: 孟冬祭神州地祇，以太宗配。
units.en: In the first month of winter, sacrifice to the Spirit Land of the Realm, with Taizong as associated deity.
units.literal: In the first month of winter, sacrifice to the Spirit Land of the Realm, with Taizong as associated deity.

units.zh: 社以后土，稷以后稷配。
units.en: The altar of soil is associated with Queen Earth; the altar of grain with Houji.
units.literal: The altar of soil with Queen Earth; the altar of grain with Houji as associated deity.

units.zh: 吉亥祭神農，以后稷配，而朝日、夕月無配。
units.en: On the auspicious hai day, sacrifice to the Divine Farmer, with Houji as associated deity; the morning sun and evening moon have no associated deity.
units.literal: On the auspicious hai day, sacrifice to the Divine Farmer, with Houji as associated deity; the morning sun and evening moon have no associated deity.

units.zh: 席，尊者以槀秸，卑者以莞。
units.en: For seating, the honored use straw mats; the humble use sedge.
units.literal: For seating, the honored use straw mats; the humble use sedge.

units.zh: 此神位之序也。
units.en: This is how spirit positions are ordered.
units.literal: This is the order of spirit positions.

units.zh: 以太尊實汎齊，著尊實醴齊，犧尊實盎齊，山罍實酒，皆二；
units.en: The great vessel holds the first libation, the sacrificial vessel the second, the offering vessel the third, mountain urns wine—two each;
units.literal: The great vessel is filled with the first libation, the sacrificial vessel with the second, the offering vessel with the third, mountain urns with wine—all two each;

units.zh: 以象尊實醍齊，壺尊實沈齊，皆二；
units.en: the image vessel the fourth libation, jar vessels the fifth—two each;
units.literal: the image vessel with the fourth libation, jar vessels with the fifth—all two each;

units.zh: 山罍實酒四：以祀昊天上帝、皇地祇、神州地祇。
units.en: mountain urns with wine, four—for sacrificing to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, August Earth Lord, and Spirit Land of the Realm.
units.literal: mountain urns with wine, four: for sacrificing to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven, the August Earth Lord, and the Spirit Land of the Realm.

units.zh: 以著尊實汎齊，犧尊實醴齊，象尊實盎齊，山罍實酒，皆二，以祀配帝。
units.en: Sacrificial vessel with first libation, offering vessel with second, image vessel with third, mountain urns with wine—two each—for associated deities.
units.literal: The sacrificial vessel with the first libation, the offering vessel with the second, the image vessel with the third, mountain urns with wine—all two each—for sacrificing to associated deities.

units.zh: 以著尊二實醴齊，以祀內官。
units.en: Two sacrificial vessels filled with the second libation—for inner officials.
units.literal: Two sacrificial vessels filled with the second libation—for sacrificing to inner officials.

units.zh: 以犧尊二實盎齊，以祀中官。
units.en: Two offering vessels filled with the third libation—for central officials.
units.literal: Two offering vessels filled with the third libation—for sacrificing to central officials.

units.zh: 以象尊二實醍齊，以祀外官。
units.en: Two image vessels filled with the fourth libation—for outer officials.
units.literal: Two image vessels filled with the fourth libation—for sacrificing to outer officials.

units.zh: 以壺尊二實昔酒，以祀眾星、日、月。
units.en: Two jar vessels filled with aged wine—for the host of stars, sun, and moon.
units.literal: Two jar vessels filled with aged wine—for sacrificing to the host of stars, sun, and moon.

units.zh: 以上皆有坫。
units.en: All of the above have stands beneath them.
units.literal: All the above have stands.

units.zh: 迎氣，五方帝、五人帝以六尊，惟山罍皆減上帝之半。
units.en: For receiving the qi, the Five Directional Emperors and Five Human Emperors use six vessels; only the mountain urns are half those for the Supreme Lord.
units.literal: For receiving the qi, the Five Directional Emperors and Five Human Emperors use six vessels; only the mountain urns are reduced by half from those for the Supreme Lord.

units.zh: 五方帝大享於明堂，太尊、著尊、犧尊、山罍各二。
units.en: When the Five Directional Emperors receive great sacrifice in the Bright Hall, great vessel, sacrificial vessel, offering vessel, and mountain urn—two each.
units.literal: When the Five Directional Emperors are greatly sacrificed to in the Bright Hall, great vessel, sacrificial vessel, offering vessel, and mountain urn—two each.

units.zh: 五方帝從祀於圓丘，以太尊實汎齊，皆二。
units.en: When the Five Directional Emperors accompany sacrifice at the Round Mound, the great vessel holds the first libation—two each.
units.literal: When the Five Directional Emperors accompany sacrifice at the Round Mound, the great vessel is filled with the first libation—two each.

units.zh: 五人帝從享於明堂，以著尊實醴齊，皆二。
units.en: When the Five Human Emperors share sacrifice at the Bright Hall, the sacrificial vessel holds the second libation—two each.
units.literal: When the Five Human Emperors share in sacrifice at the Bright Hall, the sacrificial vessel is filled with the second libation—two each.

units.zh: 日、月，以太尊實醴齊，著尊實盎齊，皆二，以山罍實酒一。
units.en: For sun and moon, the great vessel holds the second libation, the sacrificial vessel the third—two each—with one mountain urn of wine.
units.literal: For sun and moon, the great vessel with the second libation, the sacrificial vessel with the third—two each—with one mountain urn of wine.

units.zh: 從祀於圓丘，以太尊二實汎齊。
units.en: When accompanying sacrifice at the Round Mound, two great vessels filled with the first libation.
units.literal: When accompanying sacrifice at the Round Mound, two great vessels filled with the first libation.

units.zh: 神州地祇從祀於方丘，以太尊二實汎齊。
units.en: When the Spirit Land of the Realm accompanies sacrifice at the Square Mound, two great vessels filled with the first libation.
units.literal: When the Spirit Land of the Realm accompanies sacrifice at the Square Mound, two great vessels filled with the first libation.

units.zh: 五官、五星、三辰、后稷，以象尊實醍齊；
units.en: The Five Officials, Five Stars, three chronograms, and Houji—the image vessel holds the fourth libation;
units.literal: The Five Officials, Five Stars, three chronograms, and Houji—the image vessel with the fourth libation;

units.zh: 七宿，以壺尊實沈齊，皆二。
units.en: the seven lodges—the jar vessel holds the fifth libation—two each.
units.literal: the seven lodges—the jar vessel with the fifth libation—all two each.

units.zh: 蜡祭，神農、伊耆氏，以著尊皆二實盎齊。
units.en: At the wax sacrifice, the Divine Farmer and Yiyi clan—two sacrificial vessels each filled with the third libation.
units.literal: At the wax sacrifice, the Divine Farmer and Yiyi clan—the sacrificial vessel, two each filled with the third libation.

units.zh: 田畯、龍、麟、朱鳥、騶虞、玄武，以壺尊實沈齊。
units.en: Field director, dragon, unicorn, vermilion bird, zouyu, and dark warrior—the jar vessel holds the fifth libation.
units.literal: Field director, dragon, unicorn, vermilion bird, zouyu, and dark warrior—the jar vessel with the fifth libation.

units.zh: 麟、羽、臝、毛、介、丘陵、墳衍、原隰、井泉、水墉、坊、郵表畷、虎、貓、昆蟲，以散尊實清酒，皆二。
units.en: Unicorn, feathered, naked, furred, shelled, hills, mounds, plains, wetlands, wells and springs, water embankments, wards, postal markers, tiger, cat, and insects—the scattered vessel with clear wine, two each.
units.literal: Unicorn, feathered, naked, furred, shelled, hills, mounds, plains, wetlands, wells and springs, water embankments, wards, postal markers, tiger, cat, and insects—the scattered vessel with clear wine, two each.

units.zh: 嶽鎮、海瀆，以山尊實醍齊。
units.en: Mountains, garrisons, seas, and rivers—the mountain vessel holds the fourth libation.
units.literal: Mountains and garrisons, seas and rivers—the mountain vessel with the fourth libation.

units.zh: 山、川、林、澤，以蜃尊實沈齊，皆二。
units.en: Mountains, rivers, forests, and marshes—the clam vessel holds the fifth libation—two each.
units.literal: Mountains, rivers, forests, and marshes—the clam vessel with the fifth libation—two each.

units.zh: 伊耆氏以上皆有坫。
units.en: Yiyi clan and above all have stands.
units.literal: Yiyi clan and above all have stands.

units.zh: 太社，以太罍實醍齊，著尊實盎齊，皆二；
units.en: The Great Altar of Soil, the great urn with fourth libation, sacrificial vessel with third—two each;
units.literal: The Great Altar of Soil, the great urn with the fourth libation, the sacrificial vessel with the third—two each;

units.zh: 山罍一。
units.en: one mountain urn.
units.literal: one mountain urn.

units.zh: 太稷，后稷氏亦如之。
units.en: The Great Altar of Grain and the Houji clan follow the same rule.
units.literal: The Great Altar of Grain and the Houji clan are likewise.

units.zh: 其餘中祀，皆以犧尊實醍齊，象尊實盎齊，山罍實酒，皆二。
units.en: Remaining middle sacrifices all use the offering vessel with fourth libation, image vessel with third, and mountain urns with wine—two each.
units.literal: The remaining middle sacrifices all use the offering vessel with the fourth libation, the image vessel with the third, and mountain urns with wine—two each.

units.zh: 小祀，皆以象尊二實醍齊。
units.en: Minor sacrifices all use two image vessels filled with the fourth libation.
units.literal: Minor sacrifices all use two image vessels filled with the fourth libation.

units.zh: 宗廟祫享，室以斝彝實明水，黃彝實鬯，皆一；
units.en: At the collective offering in the ancestral temple, each chamber: jia and yi with clear water, yellow yi with fragrant ale—one each;
units.literal: At the collective offering in the ancestral temple, each chamber: jia vessel and yi with clear water, yellow yi with fragrant ale—one each;

units.zh: 犧尊實汎齊，象尊實醴齊，著尊實盎齊，山罍實酒，皆二。
units.en: offering vessel with first libation, image vessel with second, sacrificial vessel with third, mountain urn with wine—two each.
units.literal: offering vessel with first libation, image vessel with second, sacrificial vessel with third, mountain urn with wine—two each.

units.zh: 設堂上。
units.en: These are set above in the hall.
units.literal: Set above in the hall.

units.zh: 壺尊實醍齊，大尊實沈齊，山罍實酒，皆二。
units.en: Jar vessel with fourth libation, great vessel with fifth, mountain urn with wine—two each.
units.literal: Jar vessel with fourth libation, great vessel with fifth, mountain urn with wine—two each.

units.zh: 設堂下。
units.en: These are set below in the hall.
units.literal: Set below in the hall.

units.zh: 禘享，雞彝、鳥彝一。
units.en: At the special offering, chicken yi and bird yi—one each.
units.literal: At the special offering, chicken yi and bird yi—one each.

units.zh: 時享，春、夏室以雞彝、鳥彝一，秋、冬以斝彝、黃彝一，皆有坫。
units.en: At seasonal offerings, spring and summer chambers use chicken yi and bird yi—one each; autumn and winter use jia yi and yellow yi—one each—all with stands.
units.literal: At seasonal offerings, spring and summer chambers use chicken yi and bird yi—one each; autumn and winter use jia yi and yellow yi—one each—all with stands.

units.zh: 七祀及功臣配享，以壺尊二實醍齊。
units.en: The seven sacrifices and meritorious ministers who share in sacrifice use two jar vessels filled with the fourth libation.
units.literal: The seven sacrifices and meritorious ministers who share in sacrifice use two jar vessels filled with the fourth libation.

units.zh: 別廟之享，春、夏以雞彝實明水，鳥彝實鬯，皆一；
units.en: At offerings in separate temples, spring and summer: chicken yi with clear water, bird yi with fragrant ale—one each;
units.literal: At offerings in separate temples, spring and summer: chicken yi with clear water, bird yi with fragrant ale—one each;

units.zh: 犧尊實醴齊，象尊實盎齊，山罍實酒，皆二。
units.en: offering vessel with second libation, image vessel with third, mountain urn with wine—two each.
units.literal: offering vessel with second libation, image vessel with third, mountain urn with wine—two each.

units.zh: 秋、冬以斝彝、黃彝，皆一；
units.en: Autumn and winter: jia yi and yellow yi—one each;
units.literal: Autumn and winter: jia yi and yellow yi—one each;

units.zh: 著尊、壺尊、山罍皆二。
units.en: sacrificial vessel, jar vessel, and mountain urn—two each.
units.literal: sacrificial vessel, jar vessel, and mountain urn—two each.

units.zh: 太子之廟，以犧尊實醴齊，象尊實盎齊，山罍實酒，皆二。
units.en: The crown prince's temple: offering vessel with second libation, image vessel with third, mountain urn with wine—two each.
units.literal: The crown prince's temple: offering vessel with second libation, image vessel with third, mountain urn with wine—two each.

units.zh: 凡祀，五齊之上尊，必皆實明水；
units.en: For all sacrifices, the upper vessel among the five libations must be filled with clear water;
units.literal: For all sacrifices, the upper vessel among the five libations must all be filled with clear water;

units.zh: 山罍之上尊，必皆實明酒；
units.en: the upper vessel among mountain urns must be filled with clear wine;
units.literal: the upper vessel among mountain urns must all be filled with clear wine;

units.zh: 小祀之上尊，亦實明水。
units.en: the upper vessel for minor sacrifices also uses clear water.
units.literal: the upper vessel for minor sacrifices also uses clear water.

units.zh: 此尊爵之數也。
units.en: These are the prescribed numbers of vessels and goblets.
units.literal: These are the numbers of vessels and goblets.

units.zh: 冬至，祀昊天上帝以蒼璧。
units.en: At the winter solstice, sacrifice to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven with the dark-green disc.
units.literal: At the winter solstice, sacrifice to the August Supreme Lord of Heaven with the dark-green disc.

units.zh: 上辛，明堂以四圭有邸，與配帝之幣皆以蒼，內官以下幣如方色。
units.en: On the first xin day, the Bright Hall uses the four gui with base; silks for associated deities are all green; silks for inner officials and below follow their directional colors.
units.literal: On the first xin day, the Bright Hall uses the four gui with base; silks for associated deities are all green; silks for inner officials and below follow their directional colors.

units.zh: 皇地祇以黃琮，與配帝之幣皆以黃。
units.en: The August Earth Lord uses the yellow cong; silks for associated deities are all yellow.
units.literal: The August Earth Lord uses the yellow cong; silks for associated deities are all yellow.

units.zh: 青帝以青圭，赤帝以赤璋，黃帝以黃琮，白帝以白琥，黑帝以黑璜；
units.en: The Green Emperor uses the green gui, Red Emperor the red zhang, Yellow Emperor the yellow cong, White Emperor the white hu, Black Emperor the black huang;
units.literal: The Green Emperor uses the green gui, the Red Emperor the red zhang, the Yellow Emperor the yellow cong, the White Emperor the white hu, the Black Emperor the black huang;

units.zh: 幣如其玉。
units.en: silks match their jades.
units.literal: silks match their jades.

units.zh: 日以圭、璧，幣以青；
units.en: The sun uses gui and bi; silks are green;
units.literal: The sun uses gui and bi; silks are green;

units.zh: 月以圭、璧，幣以白。
units.en: the moon uses gui and bi; silks are white.
units.literal: the moon uses gui and bi; silks are white.

units.zh: 神州、社、稷以兩圭有邸，幣以黑；
units.en: The Spirit Land and altars of soil and grain use paired gui with base; silks are black;
units.literal: The Spirit Land, altars of soil and grain use paired gui with base; silks are black;

units.zh: 嶽鎮、海瀆以兩圭有邸，幣如其方色。
units.en: mountains, garrisons, seas, and rivers use paired gui with base; silks match their directional colors.
units.literal: mountains, garrisons, seas, and rivers use paired gui with base; silks match their directional colors.

units.zh: 神農之幣以赤，伊耆以黑，五星以方色，先農之幣以青，先蠶之幣以黑，配坐皆如之。
units.en: Silks for the Divine Farmer are red, Yiyi black, Five Stars their directional colors, First Farmer green, First Silkworm black; associated seats follow the same rule.
units.literal: Silks for the Divine Farmer are red, for Yiyi black, for the Five Stars their directional colors, for the First Farmer green, for the First Silkworm black; associated seats are likewise.

units.zh: 它祀幣皆以白，其長丈八尺。
units.en: The silk offerings for all other sacrifices are white and measure one zhang and eight chi in length.
units.literal: The silk offerings for all other sacrifices are white and measure one zhang and eight chi in length.

units.zh: 此玉、幣之制也。
units.en: These are the regulations governing jade and silks.
units.literal: These are the regulations for jade and silks.

units.zh: 冬至祀圓丘，昊天上帝、配帝，籩十二、豆十二、簋一、簠一、㽅一、俎一。
units.en: Winter solstice sacrifice at the Round Mound—for the August Supreme Lord of Heaven and associated deity: twelve bian, twelve dou, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.
units.literal: At the winter solstice sacrifice at the Round Mound, the August Supreme Lord of Heaven and associated deity: twelve bian, twelve dou, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.

units.zh: 五方上帝、大明、夜明，籩八、豆八、簋一、簠一、㽅一、俎一。
units.en: Five Directional Emperors, Bright Luminary, and Night Luminary: eight bian, eight dou, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.
units.literal: The Five Directional Emperors, Bright Luminary, and Night Luminary: eight bian, eight dou, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.

units.zh: 五星、十二辰、河漢及內官、中官，籩二、豆二、簋一、簠一、俎一。
units.en: Five Stars, twelve chronograms, River Han, and inner and central officials: two bian, two dou, one gui, one fu, one zu.
units.literal: The Five Stars, twelve chronograms, River Han, and inner and central officials: two bian, two dou, one gui, one fu, one zu.

units.zh: 外官眾星，籩、豆、簋、簠、俎各一。
units.en: Outer officials and host of stars: one bian, one dou, one gui, one fu, one zu each.
units.literal: Outer officials and host of stars: one bian, one dou, one gui, one fu, one zu each.

units.zh: 正月上辛，祈穀圓丘，昊天、配帝、五方帝，如冬至。
units.en: First upper day of the first month, prayer for grain at the Round Mound—for the August Supreme Lord, associated deity, and Five Directional Emperors—as at the winter solstice.
units.literal: On the first upper day of the first month, prayer for grain at the Round Mound—the August Supreme Lord, associated deity, and Five Directional Emperors—as at the winter solstice.

units.zh: 孟夏雩祀圓丘，昊天、配帝、五方帝，如冬至。
units.en: First month of summer, rain sacrifice at the Round Mound—as at the winter solstice.
units.literal: In the first month of summer, rain sacrifice at the Round Mound—the August Supreme Lord, associated deity, and Five Directional Emperors—as at the winter solstice.

units.zh: 五人帝，籩四、豆四、簋一、簠一、俎一。
units.en: Five Human Emperors: four bian, four dou, one gui, one fu, one zu.
units.literal: The Five Human Emperors: four bian, four dou, one gui, one fu, one zu.

units.zh: 五官，籩二、豆二、簋一、簠一、俎一。
units.en: Five Officials: two bian, two dou, one gui, one fu, one zu.
units.literal: The Five Officials: two bian, two dou, one gui, one fu, one zu.

units.zh: 季秋大享明堂，如雩祀。
units.en: Last month of autumn, great sacrifice in the Bright Hall—as at the rain sacrifice.
units.literal: In the last month of autumn, great sacrifice in the Bright Hall—as at the rain sacrifice.

units.zh: 立春祀青帝及太昊氏，籩豆皆十二、簋一、簠一、㽅一、俎一。
units.en: At the beginning of spring, sacrifice to the Green Emperor and Taihao: twelve bian and dou each, one gui, one fu, one deng, one zu.
units.literal: At the beginning of spring, sacrifice to the Green Emperor and Taihao: twelve bian and dou each, one gui, one fu, one deng, one zu.

units.zh: 歲星、三辰、句芒、七宿，籩二、豆二、簋一、簠一、俎一。
units.en: Year Star, three chronograms, Goumang, seven lodges: two bian, two dou, one gui, one fu, one zu.
units.literal: Year Star, three chronograms, Goumang, seven lodges: two bian, two dou, one gui, one fu, one zu.

units.zh: 其赤帝、黃帝、白帝、黑帝皆如之。
units.en: The Red, Yellow, White, and Black Emperors follow the same rule.
units.literal: The Red, Yellow, White, and Black Emperors are all likewise.

units.zh: 䄍祭百神，大明、夜明，籩十、豆十、簋一、簠一、㽅一、俎一。
units.en: Wax sacrifice to the hundred spirits—Bright Luminary and Night Luminary: ten bian, ten dou, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.
units.literal: At the wax sacrifice to the hundred spirits, Bright Luminary and Night Luminary: ten bian, ten dou, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.

units.zh: 神農、伊耆，籩、豆各四，簋、簠、㽅、俎各一。
units.en: Divine Farmer and Yiyi: four bian and four dou each, one gui, fu, xing, and zu each.
units.literal: Divine Farmer and Yiyi: four bian and four dou each, one gui, fu, xing, and zu each.

units.zh: 五星、十二辰、后稷、五方田畯、岳鎮、海瀆、二十八宿、五方山林川澤，籩、豆各二，簋、簠、俎各一。
units.en: Five Stars, twelve chronograms, Houji, five directional field directors, mountains and garrisons, seas and rivers, twenty-eight lodges, five directional mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes: two bian and two dou each, one gui, fu, and zu each.
units.literal: Five Stars, twelve chronograms, Houji, five directional field directors, mountains and garrisons, seas and rivers, twenty-eight lodges, five directional mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes: two bian and two dou each, one gui, fu, and zu each.

units.zh: 丘陵、墳衍、原隰、龍、麟、朱鳥、白虎、玄武、鱗、羽、毛、介、於菟等，籩、豆各一，簋、簠、俎各一。
units.en: Hills, mounds, plains, wetlands, dragon, unicorn, vermilion bird, white tiger, dark warrior, scaled, feathered, furred, shelled, yutu, and the like: one bian and one dou each, one gui, fu, and zu each.
units.literal: Hills, mounds, plains, wetlands, dragon, unicorn, vermilion bird, white tiger, dark warrior, scaled, feathered, furred, shelled, yutu, and the like: one bian and one dou each, one gui, fu, and zu each.

units.zh: 又井泉，籩、豆各一，簋、簠、俎各一。
units.en: Also wells and springs: one bian and one dou each, one gui, fu, and zu each.
units.literal: Also wells and springs: one bian and one dou each, one gui, fu, and zu each.

units.zh: 春分朝日，秋分夕月，籩十、豆十、簋一、簠一、㽅一、俎一。
units.en: Spring equinox morning sun; autumn equinox evening moon: ten bian, ten dou, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.
units.literal: At the spring equinox, morning sun; at the autumn equinox, evening moon: ten bian, ten dou, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.

units.zh: 四時祭風師、雨師、靈星、司中、司命、司人、司祿，籩八、豆八、簋一、簠一、俎一。
units.en: Four seasonal sacrifices to Wind Master, Rain Master, Spirit Star, Director in the Center, Director of Fate, Director of Humanity, and Director of Salary: eight bian, eight dou, one gui, one fu, one zu.
units.literal: Four seasonal sacrifices to the Wind Master, Rain Master, Spirit Star, Director in the Center, Director of Fate, Director of Humanity, Director of Salary: eight bian, eight dou, one gui, one fu, one zu.

units.zh: 夏至祭方丘，皇地祇及配帝，籩豆皆十二、簋一、簠一、㽅一、俎一。
units.en: Summer solstice sacrifice at the Square Mound to the August Earth Lord and associated deity: twelve bian and twelve dou each, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.
units.literal: At the summer solstice, sacrifice at the Square Mound to the August Earth Lord and associated deity: twelve bian and twelve dou each, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.

units.zh: 神州，籩四、豆四、簋一、簠一、㽅一、俎一。
units.en: Spirit Land: four bian, four dou, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.
units.literal: Spirit Land: four bian, four dou, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.

units.zh: 其五岳、四鎮、四海、四瀆及五方山川林澤，籩二、豆二，簋、簠、俎各一。
units.en: Five mountains, four garrisons, four seas, four rivers, and five directional mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes: two bian and two dou each, one gui, fu, and zu each.
units.literal: The five mountains, four garrisons, four seas, four rivers, and five directional mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes: two bian and two dou each, one gui, fu, and zu each.

units.zh: 孟冬祭神州及配帝，籩豆皆十二、簋一、簠一、㽅一、俎一。
units.en: First month of winter, sacrifice to the Spirit Land and associated deity: twelve bian and twelve dou each, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.
units.literal: In the first month of winter, sacrifice to the Spirit Land and associated deity: twelve bian and twelve dou each, one gui, one fu, one xing, one zu.

units.zh: 春、秋祭太社、太稷及配坐，籩豆皆十、簋二、簠二、鈃三、俎三。
units.en: Spring and autumn sacrifices to the Great Altars of Soil and Grain and associated seats: ten bian and ten dou each, two gui, two fu, three xing, three zu.
units.literal: Spring and autumn sacrifices to the Great Altars of Soil and Grain and associated seats: ten bian and ten dou each, two gui, two fu, three xing, three zu.

units.zh: 四時祭馬祖、馬社、先牧、馬步，籩豆皆八、簋一、簠一、俎一。
units.en: Four seasonal sacrifices to Horse Ancestor, Horse Altar, First Herdsman, and Horse Pace: eight bian and eight dou each, one gui, one fu, one zu.
units.literal: Four seasonal sacrifices to the Horse Ancestor, Horse Altar, First Herdsman, and Horse Pace: eight bian and eight dou each, one gui, one fu, one zu.

units.zh: 時享太廟，每室籩豆皆十二、簋二、簠二、㽅三、鈃三、俎三。
units.en: At the seasonal offerings in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, each chamber has twelve bian and twelve dou, two gui, two fu, three deng, three xing, and three zu.
units.literal: At the seasonal offerings in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, each chamber has twelve bian and twelve dou, two gui, two fu, three deng, three xing, and three zu.

units.zh: 七祀，籩二、豆二、簋二、簠二、俎一。
units.en: Seven sacrifices: two bian, two dou, two gui, two fu, one zu.
units.literal: The seven sacrifices: two bian, two dou, two gui, two fu, one zu.

units.zh: 祫享、功臣配享，如七祀。
units.en: Collective offering and meritorious ministers who share in sacrifice—as for the seven sacrifices.
units.literal: Collective offering and meritorious ministers who share in sacrifice—as for the seven sacrifices.

units.zh: 孟春祭帝社及配坐，籩豆皆十、簋二、簠二、㽅三、鈃三、俎三。
units.en: First month of spring, sacrifice to the Imperial Altar of Soil and associated seats: ten bian and ten dou each, two gui, two fu, three xing, three xing vessels, three zu.
