units.literal: In the first month of spring, sacrifice to the Imperial Altar of Soil and associated seats: ten bian and ten dou each, two gui, two fu, three xing, three xing vessels, three zu.

units.zh: 季春祭先蠶，籩豆皆十、簋二、簠二、㽅三、鈃三、俎三。
units.en: Last month of spring, sacrifice to the First Silkworm: ten bian and ten dou each, two gui, two fu, three xing, three xing vessels, three zu.
units.literal: In the last month of spring, sacrifice to the First Silkworm: ten bian and ten dou each, two gui, two fu, three xing, three xing vessels, three zu.

units.zh: 孟冬祭司寒，籩豆皆八、簋一、簠一、俎一。
units.en: First month of winter, sacrifice to the Director of Cold: eight bian and eight dou each, one gui, one fu, one zu.
units.literal: In the first month of winter, sacrifice to the Director of Cold: eight bian and eight dou each, one gui, one fu, one zu.

units.zh: 春、秋釋奠於孔宣父，先聖、先師，籩十、豆十、簋二、簠二、㽅三、鈃三、俎三；
units.en: Spring and autumn libation to Confucius the Exalted Father, First Sage and First Teacher: ten bian, ten dou, two gui, two fu, three xing, three xing vessels, three zu;
units.literal: Spring and autumn libation to Confucius the Exalted Father, the First Sage and First Teacher: ten bian, ten dou, two gui, two fu, three xing, three xing vessels, three zu;

units.zh: 若從祀，籩豆皆二、簋一、簠一、俎一。
units.en: if with accompanying sacrifice, two bian and two dou each, one gui, one fu, one zu.
units.literal: if with accompanying sacrifice, two bian and two dou each, one gui, one fu, one zu.

units.zh: 春、秋釋奠於齊太公、留侯，籩豆皆十、簋二、簠二、㽅三、鈃三、俎三。
units.en: Spring and autumn libation to Duke Tai of Qi and the Marquis Who Stayed: ten bian and ten dou each, two gui, two fu, three xing, three xing vessels, three zu.
units.literal: Spring and autumn libation to Duke Tai of Qi and the Marquis Who Stayed: ten bian and ten dou each, two gui, two fu, three xing, three xing vessels, three zu.

units.zh: 仲春祭五龍，籩豆皆八、簋一、簠一、俎一。
units.en: Second month of spring, sacrifice to the Five Dragons: eight bian and eight dou each, one gui, one fu, one zu.
units.literal: In the second month of spring, sacrifice to the Five Dragons: eight bian and eight dou each, one gui, one fu, one zu.

units.zh: 四時祭五岳、四鎮、四海、四瀆，各籩豆十、簋二、簠二、俎三。
units.en: Four seasonal sacrifices to the five mountains, four garrisons, four seas, and four rivers, each: ten bian and ten dou, two gui, two fu, three zu.
units.literal: Four seasonal sacrifices to the five mountains, four garrisons, four seas, and four rivers, each: ten bian and ten dou, two gui, two fu, three zu.

units.zh: 三年祭先代帝王及配坐，籩豆皆十、簋二、簠二、俎三。
units.en: Triennial sacrifice to ancient emperors and associated seats: ten bian and ten dou each, two gui, two fu, three zu.
units.literal: Triennial sacrifice to ancient emperors and associated seats: ten bian and ten dou each, two gui, two fu, three zu.

units.zh: 州縣祭社、稷、先聖，釋奠於先師，籩豆皆八、簋二、簠二、俎三。
units.en: Prefectures and counties sacrifice to altars of soil and grain and First Sage, and libate to the First Teacher: eight bian and eight dou each, two gui, two fu, three zu.
units.literal: Prefectures and counties sacrifice to altars of soil and grain, First Sage, and libation to the First Teacher: eight bian and eight dou each, two gui, two fu, three zu.

units.zh: 籩以石鹽、槀魚、棗栗榛菱芡之實、鹿脯、白餅、黑餅、糗餌、粉餈。
units.en: Bian contain rock salt, dried fish, dates, chestnuts, hazelnuts, water caltrop, and fox nuts; deer jerky, white cakes, black cakes, parched grain cakes, and powdered cakes.
units.literal: Bian contain rock salt, dried fish, dates, chestnuts, hazelnuts, water caltrop, and fox nuts; deer jerky, white cakes, black cakes, parched grain cakes, and powdered cakes.

units.zh: 豆以韮葅䤈醢、菁葅鹿醢、芹葅兔醢、筍葅魚醢、脾析葅豚胉、𩛆食、糝食。
units.en: Dou contain leek pickles with fermented meat, smartweed pickles with deer hash, celery pickles with rabbit hash, bamboo-shoot pickles with fish hash, spleen and tripe pickles with pork hash, fried grain, and scattered grain.
units.literal: Dou contain leek pickles with fermented meat, smartweed pickles with deer hash, celery pickles with rabbit hash, bamboo-shoot pickles with fish hash, spleen and tripe pickles with pork hash, fried grain, and scattered grain.

units.zh: 中祀之籩無糗餌、粉餈，豆無𩛆食、糝食。
units.en: Middle sacrifices omit parched grain cakes and powdered cakes from bian, and fried grain and scattered grain from dou.
units.literal: For middle sacrifices, bian lack parched grain cakes and powdered cakes; dou lack fried grain and scattered grain.

units.zh: 小祀之籩無白餅、黑餅、豆無脾析葅豚胉。
units.en: Minor sacrifices omit white and black cakes from bian, and spleen and tripe pickles with pork hash from dou.
units.literal: For minor sacrifices, bian lack white and black cakes; dou lack spleen and tripe pickles with pork hash.

units.zh: 凡用皆四者，籩以石鹽、棗實、栗黃、鹿脯；
units.en: Where four items are used, bian contain rock salt, jujubes, yellow chestnuts, and deer jerky;
units.literal: Where four items are used, bian contain rock salt, jujubes, yellow chestnuts, and deer jerky;

units.zh: 豆以芹葅兔醢、菁葅鹿醢。
units.en: dou contain celery pickles with rabbit hash and smartweed pickles with deer hash.
units.literal: dou contain celery pickles with rabbit hash and smartweed pickles with deer hash.

units.zh: 用皆二者，籩以栗黃、牛脯；
units.en: Where two items are used, bian contain yellow chestnuts and beef jerky;
units.literal: Where two items are used, bian contain yellow chestnuts and beef jerky;

units.zh: 豆以葵葅鹿醢。
units.en: dou contain mallow pickles with deer hash.
units.literal: dou contain mallow pickles with deer hash.

units.zh: 用皆一者，籩以牛脯，豆以鹿醢。
units.en: Where one item is used, bian contain beef jerky and dou contain deer hash.
units.literal: Where one item is used, bian contain beef jerky and dou contain deer hash.

units.zh: 用牛脯者，通以羊。
units.en: Where beef jerky is specified, mutton may be substituted throughout.
units.literal: Where beef jerky is used, mutton may be substituted throughout.

units.zh: 凡簠、簋皆一者，簋以稷，簠以黍。
units.en: Where there is one gui and one fu, gui contain millet and fu contain glutinous millet.
units.literal: Where there is one gui and one fu, gui contain millet and fu contain glutinous millet.

units.zh: 用皆二者，簋以黍、稷，簠以稻、梁。
units.en: Where two of each are used, gui contain glutinous and ordinary millet, fu contain rice and millet.
units.literal: Where two of each are used, gui contain glutinous and ordinary millet, fu contain rice and millet.

units.zh: 實㽅以大羹，鈃以肉羹。
units.en: The xing is filled with great broth; the xing vessel with meat broth.
units.literal: The xing is filled with great broth; the xing vessel with meat broth.

units.zh: 此籩、豆、簠、簋、㽅、鈃之實也。
units.en: These are the prescribed contents of bian, dou, gui, fu, xing, and xing vessels.
units.literal: These are the contents of bian, dou, gui, fu, xing, and xing vessels.

units.zh: 昊天上帝，蒼犢；
units.en: August Supreme Lord of Heaven: dark calf;
units.literal: The August Supreme Lord of Heaven, dark calf;

units.zh: 五方帝，方色犢；
units.en: Five Directional Emperors: calves of their directional colors;
units.literal: the Five Directional Emperors, calves of their directional colors;

units.zh: 大明，青犢；
units.en: Bright Luminary: green calf;
units.literal: the Bright Luminary, green calf;

units.zh: 夜明，白犢；
units.en: Night Luminary: white calf;
units.literal: the Night Luminary, white calf;

units.zh: 神州地祇，黑犢。
units.en: Spirit Land of the Realm: black calf.
units.literal: the Spirit Land of the Realm, black calf.

units.zh: 配帝之犢：天以蒼，地以黃，神州以黑，皆一。
units.en: Calves for associated deities: heaven dark, earth yellow, Spirit Land black—one each.
units.literal: Calves for associated deities: heaven uses dark, earth yellow, Spirit Land black—one each.

units.zh: 宗廟、太社、太稷、帝社、先蠶、古帝王、嶽鎮、海瀆，皆太牢。
units.en: Ancestral temple, Great Altars of Soil and Grain, Imperial Altar of Soil, First Silkworm, ancient emperors, mountains, garrisons, seas, and rivers—all use the great victim set.
units.literal: Ancestral temple, Great Altars of Soil and Grain, Imperial Altar of Soil, First Silkworm, ancient emperors, mountains, garrisons, seas, and rivers—all use the great victim set.

units.zh: 社、稷之牲以黑。
units.en: Victims for the altars of soil and grain are black.
units.literal: Victims for the altars of soil and grain are black.

units.zh: 五官、五星、三辰、七宿，皆少牢。
units.en: Five Officials, Five Stars, three chronograms, and seven lodges—all use the lesser victim set.
units.literal: The Five Officials, Five Stars, three chronograms, and seven lodges—all use the lesser victim set.

units.zh: 蜡祭：神農氏、伊耆氏、少牢；
units.en: Wax sacrifice: Divine Farmer clan and Yiyi clan, lesser victim set;
units.literal: At the wax sacrifice: the Divine Farmer clan and Yiyi clan, lesser victim set;

units.zh: 后稷及五方、十二次、五官、五田畯、五嶽、四鎮、海瀆、日、月，方以犢二；
units.en: Houji, five directions, twelve chronograms, five officials, five field directors, five mountains, four garrisons, seas and rivers, sun and moon—two calves of their directional colors each;
units.literal: Houji and five directions, twelve chronograms, five officials, five field directors, five mountains, four garrisons, seas and rivers, sun and moon—two calves of their directional colors each;

units.zh: 星辰以降，方皆少牢五；
units.en: stars and below, five lesser victim sets each per direction;
units.literal: stars and below, lesser victim set of five each for each direction;

units.zh: 井泉皆羊一。
units.en: wells and springs, one sheep each.
units.literal: wells and springs, one sheep each.

units.zh: 非順成之方則闕。
units.en: Where the direction has not achieved a complete harvest, it is omitted.
units.literal: Where the direction has not achieved complete harvest, it is omitted.

units.zh: 風師、雨師、靈星、司中、司命、司人、司祿、馬祖、先牧、馬社、馬步，皆羊一。
units.en: Wind Master, Rain Master, Spirit Star, Director in the Center, Director of Fate, Director of Humanity, Director of Salary, Horse Ancestor, First Herdsman, Horse Altar, and Horse Pace—all one sheep each.
units.literal: Wind Master, Rain Master, Spirit Star, Director in the Center, Director of Fate, Director of Humanity, Director of Salary, Horse Ancestor, First Herdsman, Horse Altar, and Horse Pace—all one sheep each.

units.zh: 司寒，黑牲一。
units.en: Director of Cold: one black victim.
units.literal: Director of Cold, one black victim.

units.zh: 凡牲在滌，大祀九旬，中祀三旬，小祀一旬，養而不卜。
units.en: All victims in the purification pen: great sacrifices ninety days, middle sacrifices thirty days, minor sacrifices ten days—they are raised without divination.
units.literal: For all victims in the purification pen, great sacrifices ninety days, middle sacrifices thirty days, minor sacrifices ten days—they are raised without divination.

units.zh: 無方色則用純，必有副焉。
units.en: Where there is no directional color, pure victims are used; there must always be a substitute.
units.literal: Where there is no directional color, pure victims are used; there must always be a substitute.

units.zh: 省牲而犢鳴，則免之而用副。
units.en: When inspecting victims, if the calf lows it is exempted and the substitute is used.
units.literal: When inspecting victims, if the calf lows, it is exempted and the substitute is used.

units.zh: 禁其棰柎，死則瘞之，創病者請代犢，告祈之牲不養。
units.en: Beating and rough handling are forbidden; if a victim dies it is buried; if injured, a substitute is requested; victims for prayer and announcement are not raised in the pen.
units.literal: Beating and rough handling are forbidden; if it dies it is buried; if injured, a substitute calf is requested; victims for prayer and announcement are not raised.

units.zh: 凡祀，皆以其日未明十五刻，太官令帥宰人以鸞刀割牲，祝史以豆斂毛血置饌所，祭則奉之以入，遂亨之。
units.en: For all sacrifices, at the fifteenth quarter before dawn on the sacrifice day, the Imperial Kitchen Director leads butchers to cut victims with the phoenix knife; invokers collect hair and blood in beans at the offering station; at the sacrifice these are borne in and cooked.
units.literal: For all sacrifices, at the fifteenth quarter before dawn on the sacrifice day, the Imperial Kitchen Director leads butchers to cut the victims with the phoenix knife; invokers collect hair and blood in beans and place them at the offering station; at the sacrifice they are borne in, then cooked.

units.zh: 肉載以俎，皆升右胖體十一：前節三，肩、臂、臑；
units.en: Meat is loaded on trays; all ascend the right fatty portion in eleven pieces: three from the forequarter—shoulder, arm, and shank;
units.literal: Meat is loaded on trays; all ascend the right fatty portion in eleven pieces: three from the forequarter—shoulder, arm, and shank;

units.zh: 後節二，肫、胳；
units.en: two from the hindquarter—rump and shank;
units.literal: two from the hindquarter—rump and shank;

units.zh: 正脊一，脡脊一，橫脊一，正脅一，短脅一，代脅一，皆並骨。
units.en: one spine proper, one spine extension, one cross spine, one proper rib, one short rib, one substitute rib—all with bone.
units.literal: one spine proper, one spine extension, one cross spine, one proper rib, one short rib, one substitute rib—all with bone.

units.zh: 別祭用太牢者，酒二斗，脯一段，醢四合；
units.en: Separate sacrifices using the great victim set: two dou of wine, one section of dried meat, four he of hash;
units.literal: For separate sacrifices using the great victim set: two dou of wine, one section of dried meat, four he of hash;

units.zh: 用少牢者，酒減半。
units.en: for the lesser victim set, wine is reduced by half.
units.literal: for the lesser victim set, wine is reduced by half.

units.zh: 此牲牢之別也。
units.en: These are the distinctions among the victim sets.
units.literal: These are the distinctions among victim sets.

units.zh: 祝版，其長一尺一分，廣八寸，厚二分，其木梓、楸。
units.en: Prayer boards are one foot one inch long, eight inches wide, two fen thick, of catalpa or chinaberry wood.
units.literal: Prayer boards are one foot one inch long, eight inches wide, two fen thick; the wood is catalpa or chinaberry.

units.zh: 凡大祀、中祀，署版必拜。
units.en: For all great and middle sacrifices, signing the board requires a bow.
units.literal: For all great and middle sacrifices, signing the board requires a bow.

units.zh: 皇帝親祠，至大次，郊社令以祝版進署，受以出，奠於坫。
units.en: When the emperor sacrifices in person, upon reaching the great tent the Suburban Altar Director advances the prayer board for signing; after receiving it he goes out and sets it on the stand.
units.literal: When the emperor sacrifices in person, upon reaching the great tent the Suburban Altar Director advances the prayer board for signing; after receiving it he goes out and sets it on the stand.

units.zh: 宗廟則太廟令進之。
units.en: At the ancestral temple the Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple advances it.
units.literal: At the ancestral temple the Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple advances it.

units.zh: 若有司攝事，則進而御署，皇帝北向再拜，侍臣奉版，郊社令受以出。
units.en: If a minister conducts the affair by proxy, he advances it for the emperor to sign; the emperor bows twice facing north; attendants bear the board; the Suburban Altar Director receives it and goes out.
units.literal: If a minister conducts the affair by proxy, he advances it for the emperor to sign; the emperor bows twice facing north; attendants bear the board; the Suburban Altar Director receives it and goes out.

units.zh: 皇后親祠，則郊社令預送內侍，享前一日進署，后北向再拜，近侍奉以出，授內侍送享所。
units.en: When the empress sacrifices in person, the Suburban Altar Director sends it beforehand to inner attendants; one day before the offering it is advanced for signing; the empress bows twice facing north; close attendants bear it out and hand it to inner attendants for delivery to the offering site.
units.literal: When the empress sacrifices in person, the Suburban Altar Director sends it beforehand to the inner attendants; one day before the offering it is advanced for signing; the empress bows twice facing north; close attendants bear it out and hand it to inner attendants to deliver to the offering site.

units.zh: 享日之平明，女祝奠於坫。
units.en: At dawn on the offering day, the female invoker sets it on the stand.
units.literal: At dawn on the offering day, the female invoker sets it on the stand.

units.zh: 此冊祝之制也。
units.en: These are the regulations governing prayer boards and invocations.
units.literal: These are the regulations for prayer boards and invocations.

units.zh: 校勘記
units.en: Collation notes
units.literal: Collation notes

units.zh: 尚書敬顯儁曰：「孔子云：『微管仲，吾其被發左衽矣』以此言之，右衽為是。」
units.en: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
units.literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

units.zh: 夫以廟堂、汾水，殊途而同歸，稷、契、巢、許，異名而一貫，出者稱為元首，處者謂之外臣，莫不內外相資，表裏成治，斯蓋萬代同規，百王不易者也。
units.en: Temple and Fen River were different roads to the same end; Ji, Qi, Chao, and Xu were different names for the same principle. Those who served at court were called chiefs; those who withdrew were outer ministers. Inner and outer always supported each other until government was whole. That was the rule for all ages, unchanged by the hundred kings.
units.literal: The temple hall and the Fen River were different paths yet one return; Ji, Qi, Chao, and Xu were different names yet one thread—those who went out were called chief, those who remained were called outer ministers; none failed to support inner and outer, form governance in surface and core; this was the same rule for ten thousand generations and what the hundred kings did not change.

units.zh: 按唐開元中，玄宗詔曰：「祀神以玉，取其精潔，比來用瑉，不可行也。
units.en: In Kaiyuan of Tang, Emperor Xuanzong decreed: "Spirits are worshipped with jade for its purity and refinement; the recent use of min stone cannot be permitted.
units.literal: According to Kaiyuan of Tang, Emperor Xuanzong decreed: "To sacrifice to the spirits with jade is to take its purity and refinement; recently min stone has been used—this cannot be permitted.

units.zh: 兼冊文內有『基』字，是玄宗廟諱，雖尋常詔敕皆不回避，少帝是繼世之孫，不欲斥列聖之諱，今改『基』為『宗』字。」
units.en: Moreover, the writ contains the character 'ji,' the temple taboo of Emperor Xuanzong; although ordinary edicts do not avoid it, the Lesser Emperor is a descendant in succession and we do not wish to pronounce the taboos of successive sages—'ji' is now changed to 'zong.'"
units.literal: Moreover, within the writ text is the character 'ji,' which is the temple taboo of Emperor Xuanzong; although ordinary edicts do not avoid it, the Lesser Emperor is a descendant in succession and we do not wish to pronounce the taboos of successive sages—now 'ji' is changed to the character 'zong."

units.zh: 今昭宣上去玄宗十四世，奏改冊文，非典故也。）〉
units.en: From the August and Illustrious up to Emperor Xuanzong are fourteen generations; memorializing a change to the writ text is not according to precedent.)〉
units.literal: Now from the August and Illustrious up to Emperor Xuanzong are fourteen generations; to memorialize changing the writ text is not according to precedent.)〉

units.zh: 伏詳本朝列聖之舊典，明皇定禮之新規，開元十年，特立九廟，子孫遵守，歷代無虧。
units.en: We have examined the old statutes of our dynasty's successive emperors and the new ritual regulations established under Emperor Ming; in Kaiyuan 10 nine temples were specially established, and descendants have observed this through the generations without lapse.
units.literal: Your subjects have examined in detail the old statutes of the successive sage emperors of this dynasty and the new regulations for fixing ritual under Emperor Ming; in the tenth year of Kaiyuan nine temples were specially established, observed by descendants through the generations without impairment.

units.zh: 唐初悉用祝版，唯陵廟用玉冊，玄皇親祭郊廟，用玉為冊。
units.en: Early Tang used prayer boards exclusively; only imperial tombs and temples used jade tablets, and when the August Sovereign personally sacrificed at suburban altars and temples, jade tablets were employed.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tang all used prayer boards; only imperial tombs and temples used jade tablets, and when the August Sovereign personally sacrificed at suburban altars and temples, jade was used for tablets.

units.zh: 聖朝中興，重修宗廟，今太廟見饗高祖、太宗、懿宗、昭宗、獻祖、太祖、莊宗七廟，太祖景皇帝在祧廟之數，不列廟饗。
units.en: After the dynasty's revival the ancestral shrines were rebuilt; the Imperial Temple now served seven halls—the High Ancestor, Great Ancestor, Yizong, Zhaozong, Xianzu, Taizu, and Zhuangzong—while Grand Ancestor Emperor Jing was relegated to the distant-lineage shrine and no longer received regular temple offerings.
units.literal: When the sacred court restored the dynasty and rebuilt the ancestral temples, the Imperial Ancestral Temple now offers sacrifices to seven temples: the High Ancestor, Great Ancestor, Yizong, Zhaozong, Xianzu, Taizu, and Zhuangzong. The Grand Ancestor Emperor Jing is counted among the distant ancestral temples and is not listed for temple sacrifice.

units.zh: 如或以玉難辦，寧小其制度，以取其真。」
units.en: If jade is hard to obtain, it is better to reduce the prescribed dimensions than sacrifice authenticity."
units.literal: If jade is difficult to obtain, it is better to reduce the scale of the regulations so as to preserve authenticity."

units.zh: 至如國朝，太祖曰景皇帝，以受命而有唐室，宣宗皇帝以隔代承運，皇綱復振故也。
units.en: In our dynasty, the Grand Ancestor is called Emperor Jing because he received the Mandate and possessed the Tang house; Emperor Xuanzong because he received the fortune across generations and restored the imperial norm.
units.literal: As for our dynasty, the Grand Ancestor is called Emperor Jing because he received the Mandate and possessed the Tang house; Emperor Xuanzong because he received the fortune across generations and the imperial norm was restored.

units.zh: 與梁人泛言氏族，袁狎曰：「未若我本出自黃帝，姓在十四之限。」
units.en: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said, "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."
units.literal: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said: "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."

units.zh: 李渾 子湛 渾弟繪 族子公緒 李璵 弟瑾 族弟曉 鄭述祖 子元德
units.en: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande
units.literal: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande

units.zh: 顓頊帝高陽氏
units.en: Emperor Zhuanxu Gaoyang
units.literal: Zhuanxu Emperor, the Gaoyang clan

units.zh: 自太昊已降，五運相推，迄於殷湯，歷數綿永。
units.en: From Taihao onward, the five cycles succeeded one another, and down to Tang of Yin the dynastic span endured without end.
units.literal: From Taihao downward, the five cycles succeeded one another; down to Tang of Yin, the dynastic span was long and enduring.

units.zh: 父让，王莽时为城门校尉，封脩远伯，使奉少昊后，寓于北地而卒。
units.en: His father Liang Rang, under Wang Mang, was colonel of the gates, enfeoffed Baron Xiuyuan to sacrifice to Shaohao, then moved to Beidi and died there.
units.literal: His father Rang, in Wang Mang's time was colonel of the gates, enfeoffed as baron of Xiuyuan, and was sent to continue the line of Shaohao; he lodged in Beidi and died.
